rows.original: [kase.isCrew |Your always-diligent logistics officer Kase is waiting just inside the ship. “New crew member, captain, or just a temporary passenger?” You tell him briefly of the arrangement with the prison, informing him of who Sam is and that she will be staying on your ship for the time being. Kase looks a bit apprehensive at the news that a pirate hacker will be living on the ship, but he speaks to her in the same measured tone he used with you. “Is this all you will be bringing aboard, Ms. Tyraso?” Sam tries to think through the cloud of drugs fogging her brain, eventually nodding an affirmative. The green-haired feline approaches her somewhat gingerly and checks the contents of the box. It turns out to contain basic essentials like toiletries, but it’s a rather spartan set and a meager supply of them. Kase takes note of the items and tuts a bit. “Hmm, the absolute bare essentials, but hardly more than enough to last a day. Captain, with your permission I’d like to send a few more supplies to Ms. Tyraso’s quarters.” Sam dumbly wags her tail a bit at the kaithrit boy. She doesn’t seem to really understand his words, so you give your assent and thank him on her behalf before dismissing him. He salutes you crisply. “You’re welcome, captain. Let me know if there’s anything else I can do for either of you.” Then he turns on his heel and goes about his business. Once you’ve finished checking in with Kase, |Once inside, ] you lead Sam to her new quarters, where you take the box from her and sit the sleepy pup on the bed. She doesn’t seem truly aware of her surroundings, and simply lies down, curling up in the fetal position with her bushy ausar tail wrapped [sam.isPregnant |protectively around her pregnant belly |around herself for warmth. ][pc.nmh | Feeling sorry for the shivering girl, you tug the sheets up to help her stay warm. Once you’ve covered Sam up, her tail wags gently in her sleep, swishing against the fabric of her bedding. | Feeling sorry for the shivering girl, you tug the sheets up to help her stay warm. Once you’ve covered Sam up, her tail wags gently in her sleep, swishing against the fabric of her bedding. ] Looking inside the box, it seems to be just basic essentials, toiletries and the like. She must not have had any possessions that weren’t confiscated, other than her clothes. Figuring it’s better not to take any chances, you set the controls for the door to Sam’s room so that it can only be opened from the outside. You don’t want her waking up while you’re flying around and doing anything crazy. With that done, you head to the controls of your ship and begin the process of flying back to Tavros. Once you’ve finished the launching protocols and been cleared by the control tower, you set the ship to auto-pilot and open up your codex to check the message you received. It’s a very business-like explanation of the collar that Sam has been fitted with — there’s even an official manual included as an attachment. The manual boasts that the Carver Consolidated Organic Lifeform Pacification Device is part of a class of ‘humane’ restraining devices known as ‘chemical restraints’, so named because the devices administer chemicals to the wearer to encourage, discourage, or outright force (or prevent) whatever behavior the controller of the device wishes while monitoring the wearer’s vitals in order to automatically avoid overdose. The message from Gastigoth informs you that this particular collar has been equipped with sedatives, stimulants, aphrodisiacs, birth control, and fertility enhancers; additionally, it can be controlled by the attuned remote, by voice, or in response to specific actions on the wearer’s part, such as attempting to remove the collar themselves. Other triggering conditions may be set via synchronized data slate, with anything from location, to the wearer’s heart rate, to specific times of day. Extensive health and vital information about the wearer can also be monitored from a data slate, including pregnancy — which the manual is quick to explain will not be at risk from any officially-provided or sponsored drugs the collar can be filled with. It seems you have quite the impressive little piece of technology here!

rows.original: You study the manual until you are out of the system, pocketing the remote control for the collar and [pc.walk]ing back to Sam’s quarters. Unlocking the door, you enter your new ward’s room. The blonde girl is sitting at the head of her bed with her knees pressed up to her modest chest and her furry arms wrapped around her shins. Her ears are as flat as an ausar’s can be, and they don’t perk up at all when you enter, nor does she make eye contact with you. She just keeps a stony expression and stares straight ahead. Void, you could cut the tension with a knife! You [pc.nmh |awkwardly clear your throat and ask Sam how she’s feeling. |cough and ask how the weather is. |curtly demand to know what her status is. ] She still doesn’t look at you, but she lifts her head from between her knees to speak. “Fine... I’m still kind of groggy, but it’s not so bad.” She pauses for a long while, clearly searching for the right words before finally finding them and looking straight at you with her big blue eyes. “Umm... who are you?” What. Does she seriously not remember [sam.fought |shooting at you and being fucked by you |fucking you ]? Anger flashes across Sam’s face momentarily when she thinks she realizes who you are, but it’s replaced quickly by a look of total defeat. She shakes her head with a regretful expression on her scarred face. “It’s all just kind of a blur. I sort of vaguely remember someone, but not you in particular. All of the time between that botched kidnapping and now has been pretty hazy. When I got knocked out on that last job, I lost my memory of what was happening in the last few minutes before that. I just remember waking up in a police cruiser. You weren’t mentioned at the trial or sentencing either. I can recall almost all of my time at Gastigoth, but those damn sedatives they use make it so you don’t really remember anything while you’re on them, so I don’t clearly remember meeting anyone in the breeding program.” The ausar looks away from you again before muttering, “I’m not even really sure how I got where I am right now. Or even where I am at all...” She might have been a hardened pirate, but looking at Sam as she is now, vulnerable and bereft of guile, she just seems like a scared young woman. You would’ve expected her to at least act surly or even angry with you, but instead she seems resigned to whatever fate you have in store for her, if incredibly anxious about it. [pc.nmh |You open your arms in a disarming gesture, trying to show you have no hostile intent as you approach her bed and sit on the edge of it. You tell her that you are [pc.name] Steele, and that this is your ship, then explain to her that you don’t plan on doing anything terrible to her or harshly exploiting her. You just enjoyed having sex with her in prison and wanted to be able to do so at your leisure, in more comfortable conditions. |You open your arms in a disarming gesture, trying to show you have no hostile intent as you approach her bed and sit on the edge of it. You tell her that you are [pc.name] Steele, and that this is your ship, then explain to her that you don’t plan on doing anything terrible to her or harshly exploiting her. You just enjoyed having sex with her in prison and wanted to be able to do so at your leisure, in more comfortable conditions. |You roll your eyes and take a seat on her bed, ordering her to look at you. When she does, you tell her in no uncertain terms that you are [pc.name] Steele, that she’s on your ship right now, and that you won’t be doing anything she won’t like as long as she doesn’t give you reason to. ][pc.isBimbo | You giggle disarmingly and sashay over to the bed, hoping to draw her attention with a sexy swing of your [pc.hips]. When that doesn’t work, you take a seat on the edge of her bed as sensual a manner as possible. You introduce yourself as [pc.name] Steele and tell her that she’s on your ship. You also let her know in a flirting tone that you’d never do anything bad to a cutie like her. ] Sam visibly relaxes, becoming much less tense and wagging her tail the smallest little bit. She even looks back at you, though her expression is still quite cool. “Well, I don’t think I’d mind that. Being chained up like that was so damn hot, but I never really got to enjoy it fully ‘cause of the drugs.” At that, her ears droop a bit again as an apprehensive look crosses her face. “You’re not going to keep using those every time, right?” she asks softly. You shake your head, telling her you won’t use the sedatives [pc.nmh |as long as she gives you no reason to. |unless she really wants you to. |if she doesn’t do anything stupid. ] Sam’s ears perk again as she relaxes a bit. “Okay, good. I was worried you might be some kind of sicko.” There’s [pc.nmh |a tiny pang of guilt in your heart |a tiny pang of guilt in your heart |not a bit of remorse in your heart ][pc.isBro | not a bit of remorse in your heart ] when she says this, as you certainly enjoyed yourself in the prison. You skip right over it though and reassure her, letting her know you’re interested only in the aphrodisiacs, if you even intend to use her collar at all. The dark-skinned ausar retreats into her shell again, looking tense and fearful once more. “Umm, about that. I know if you use those, I’m gonna get really baby-crazy. You shouldn’t listen to me though. That’s just the heat talking! I don’t want to have my pups end up being raised in Gastigoth or something like- uh, I just don’t want them there.” There’s obviously something serious in that cut-off sentence, but you don’t pry just yet. Plenty of time for that later. Instead you tell Sam of the nursery your father left for you on Tavros, and how it has everything a parent could ask for for their children. You would never send your children to be raised in a corporate prison, especially when you have a much better alternative. Sam’s blue eyes widen as your explanation goes on, and relief washes over her. She finally lets one of her blonde-furred legs stretch out in front of her as she sighs out much of her tension. “Haaa... That’s a relief. Now I don’t have to worry so much if you knock me up. I’ve got to admit, the idea of being tied up helplessly and having somebody cum in me over and over until I’m pregnant is really fucking hot. It’s the fact that I’d have pups to raise about 8 months afterwards that I don’t like.” Well that’s certainly understandable. Still, she signed up for the breeding program, so she must not object too strongly to the idea, especially in light of finding out about your nursery. Sam doesn’t dignify your comment with a response, but she doesn’t deny your words. Before the ensuing silence can grow too awkward, you tell her you should be arriving at Tavros soon, so you need to prepare for docking protocols. In a tone that shows she already knows the answer to the question, Sam asks, “Am I going to be allowed to leave the ship when you do?” [pc.nmh |You shake your head ruefully and apologize. |You shake your head ruefully and apologize. |You scoff at her question and tell her you’re not taking any chances. ] “Okay,” Sam mutters defeatedly. The canid girl rolls over on her side with her back to you, meekly accepting her situation and curling her bushy blonde tail around herself again defensively. You make your departure, locking the door to her room behind you before returning to the cockpit. You’ll have to give Sam some time to adjust to her new surroundings and suss out how much you can trust her in the coming days.
rows.translation: 你研读着说明手册，直到退出系统，随后把项圈的遥控器揣进口袋，[pc.walk]回萨姆的舱室。你解开门锁，走进这位新监护对象的房间。金发女孩坐在床头，双膝抵着她那不算丰满的胸脯，毛茸茸的双臂环抱着小腿。她的耳朵已经伏到了奥萨人所能做到的最低程度；你进门时，那双耳朵完全没有竖起，她也没和你对视。她只是神情僵硬地直视前方。虚空在上，这紧张气氛简直能用刀切开！ rows.original: Walking along the corridor of your ship, you suddenly receive an urgent message, one flagged top priority. You go through a mental checklist, narrowing down who might have sent you such a thing, but as you open the message you see that it’s from Sam. Two words, extremely direct.
rows.translation: 走在飞船走廊中，你突然收到一条标记为最高优先级的紧急消息。你在脑中逐一排查，猜测谁会给你发来这种东西，可打开消息后，你发现发信人是萨姆。只有两个词，直截了当。

rows.original: You don’t even need to think for a moment about what it means. Sam is going into labor! You drop everything and head straight for the medbay, meeting up with the whelping ausar woman and immediately rushing to her side. She’s already changed into a gown when you arrive, her huge belly having shifted noticeably lower.
rows.translation: 你根本无须思考它是什么意思。萨姆要分娩了！你扔下手头的一切，直奔医疗舱，与即将生产的奥萨尔女人会合，立刻赶到她身边。你抵达时她已经换上病号服，巨大的腹部明显向下坠了许多。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t even need to think for a moment about what it means. Sam is going into labor! You drop everything and head straight for the medbay, meeting up with the whelping ausar woman and immediately rushing to her side. She’s already changed into a gown when you arrive, her huge belly having shifted noticeably lower."

rows.original: “Hey, [pc.name],” Sam mutters, obviously distracted, though her tail does perk up a bit as she sees you[sam.trustRange 0 50| in spite of her usual caution around you]. “Don’t worry, I’ve [sam.pupsRange 0|been studying|been through this before]. I’ve kept up with my prenatal exercises, so I’ll be fine.”
rows.translation: “嘿，[pc.name]，”萨姆低声说道，显然有些心不在焉，不过看到你时，她的尾巴确实稍稍竖了起来[sam.trustRange 0 50|，尽管她平时仍对你有所戒备]。“别担心，我已经[sam.pupsRange 0|学习过相关知识|经历过这种事]。我一直坚持产前锻炼，所以不会有事的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, [pc.name],” Sam mutters, obviously distracted, though her tail does perk up a bit as she sees you[sam.trustRange 0 50| in spite of her usual caution around you]. “Don’t worry, I’ve [sam.pupsRange 0|been studying|been through this before]. I’ve kept up with my prenatal exercises, so I’ll be fine.”"

rows.original: You’re glad to hear it, though the blonde sounds as much like she’s trying to convince herself as she is trying to convince you. You take her furred hand and give it a reassuring squeeze, her other hand resting on her tummy.
rows.translation: 听她这么说，你很高兴，尽管这个金发女孩听起来既像是在说服你，也同样像在说服自己。你握住她毛茸茸的手，安慰地捏了捏；她的另一只手则放在肚子上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re glad to hear it, though the blonde sounds as much like she’s trying to convince herself as she is trying to convince you. You take her furred hand and give it a reassuring squeeze, her other hand resting on her tummy. "

rows.original: “I don’t have the biggest hips, so it’s a lot easier for me to whelp standing than lying down,” she hisses as a wave of labor pain wracks her, but she grits her teeth for a moment and comes through it calm again. “But that’s a lot easier thanks to having you here with me... thank you.” She shyly kisses you on the cheek[sam.trustRange 0 75| much to your surprise].
rows.translation: “我的胯不算特别宽，所以站着生比躺着容易多了，”一阵产痛席卷全身，她倒抽着气说道；不过她咬紧牙关熬了一会儿，很快又恢复了平静。“但有你陪着我，这就容易多了...谢谢你。”她羞涩地亲了亲你的脸颊[sam.trustRange 0 75|，令你十分意外]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t have the biggest hips, so it’s a lot easier for me to whelp standing than lying down,” she hisses as a wave of labor pain wracks her, but she grits her teeth for a moment and comes through it calm again. “But that’s a lot easier thanks to having you here with me... thank you.” She shyly kisses you on the cheek[sam.trustRange 0 75| much to your surprise]."

rows.original: You spend the next few hours with Sam, doing your best to keep her relaxed. She wasn’t boasting about keeping up with her prenatal exercises, as she has little trouble with labor pains after the first hour or so. That’s in no small part thanks to the flood of hormones that soon fills her brain: Sam is downright perky even as sweat drips down her face from the muscular effort.
rows.translation: 接下来的几个小时，你一直陪着萨姆，尽力让她保持放松。她说自己一直坚持产前锻炼并不是吹牛，最初一小时左右过去后，产痛几乎没给她造成什么麻烦。这很大程度上也得益于很快涌入她大脑的大量激素：即便肌肉发力令汗水不断淌过脸颊，萨姆仍精神得惊人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend the next few hours with Sam, doing your best to keep her relaxed. She wasn’t boasting about keeping up with her prenatal exercises, as she has little trouble with labor pains after the first hour or so. That’s in no small part thanks to the flood of hormones that soon fills her brain: Sam is downright perky even as sweat drips down her face from the muscular effort."

rows.original: She carefully squats or sits down from time to time, fairly casually, considering the circumstance, watching a video or playing a game on her tablet, but the ausar girl maintains her deep, regular breathing, and stops what she’s doing occasionally to push. Sometimes she makes conversation with you, obviously giddy with anticipation about meeting her future kid
rows.translation: 考虑到眼下的状况，她不时小心蹲下或坐下，态度颇为随意，看看视频，或在平板上玩游戏；不过这个奥萨尔女孩始终保持深沉而规律的呼吸，偶尔会停下手头的事用力生产。有时她会和你交谈，显然因即将见到自己未来的孩子

rows.original: That’s easy enough to tell, as whenever there’s a lull in her labor, Sam proceeds to talk your ear off, something you’re not entirely accustomed to from the normally reserved woman. With your help she moves through a whole range of positions as the hours pass, talking to you or playing on her tablet the entire time as she sits, stands, squats down, drops on her hands and knees, or grips the edge of the bed and rolls her hips. She works up a sheen of sweat, but the whelping ausar’s head is so full of endorphins that she acts as though she’s chatting with you over coffee.
rows.translation: 这一点再明显不过：每当阵痛稍歇，萨姆便开始在你耳边说个不停，你可不太习惯这个平日沉默寡言的女人如此健谈。几个小时过去，在你的帮助下，她换遍了各种姿势；无论坐着、站着、蹲下、四肢着地，还是抓住床沿扭动腰胯，她始终一边与你聊天，一边在平板上玩游戏。她浑身渗出一层细汗，可这个正在分娩的奥萨尔脑中充满内啡肽，表现得就像在和你喝咖啡闲聊一样轻松。

rows.original: You’re glad to hear it, though the blonde sounds as much like she’s trying to convince herself as she is trying to convince you. You take her furred hand and give it a reassuring squeeze, her other hand resting on her tummy.
rows.translation: 听她这么说，你很高兴，尽管这个金发女孩听起来既像是在说服你，也同样像在说服自己。你握住她毛茸茸的手，安慰地捏了捏；她的另一只手则放在肚子上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re glad to hear it, though the blonde sounds as much like she’s trying to convince herself as she is trying to convince you. You take her furred hand and give it a reassuring squeeze, her other hand resting on her tummy."

rows.original: Briget chimes in with a warm, calming tone. “You’ve got the best care in the whole galaxy here, dear. Nothing will go wrong on my watch.” That calms the ausar down a great deal, and she smiles at the matronly gynoid.
rows.translation: 布丽吉特以温暖、平和的语气插话道：“亲爱的，你在这里能得到全银河最好的护理。只要有我看着，就绝不会出问题。”这让奥萨尔安心了许多，她冲这位慈母般的女性机器人露出微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nBriget chimes in with a warm, calming tone. “You’ve got the best care in the whole galaxy here, dear. Nothing will go wrong on my watch.” That calms the ausar down a great deal, and she smiles at the matronly gynoid."

rows.original: Turning back to you, Sam explains, “I don’t have the biggest hips, so it’s a lot easier for me to give birth standing,” she hisses as a wave of labor pain wracks her, but she grits her teeth for a moment and comes through it calm again. “But that’s a lot easier since I have you here with me... thank you.” She shyly kisses you on the cheek[sam.trustRange 0 75|, much to your surprise].
rows.translation: 萨姆转回来看着你，解释道：“我的胯不算特别宽，所以站着生孩子容易多了，”一阵产痛席卷全身，她倒抽着气说道；不过她咬紧牙关熬了一会儿，很快又恢复了平静。“但有你陪着我，这就容易多了...谢谢你。”她羞涩地亲了亲你的脸颊[sam.trustRange 0 75|，令你十分意外]。
rows.raw: "\n\nTurning back to you, Sam explains, “I don’t have the biggest hips, so it’s a lot easier for me to give birth standing,” she hisses as a wave of labor pain wracks her, but she grits her teeth for a moment and comes through it calm again. “But that’s a lot easier since I have you here with me... thank you.” She shyly kisses you on the cheek[sam.trustRange 0 75|, much to your surprise]."

rows.original: You spend the next few hours with Sam, doing your best to keep her relaxed. She wasn’t boasting about keeping up with her prenatal exercises, as she has little trouble with labor pains after the first hour or so. That’s in no small part thanks to the flood of hormones that soon fills her brain: Sam is downright perky even as sweat drips down her face from the muscular effort.
rows.translation: 接下来的几个小时，你一直陪着萨姆，尽力让她保持放松。她说自己一直坚持产前锻炼并不是吹牛，最初一小时左右过去后，产痛几乎没给她造成什么麻烦。这很大程度上也得益于很快涌入她大脑的大量激素：即便肌肉发力令汗水不断淌过脸颊，萨姆仍精神得惊人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend the next few hours with Sam, doing your best to keep her relaxed. She wasn’t boasting about keeping up with her prenatal exercises, as she has little trouble with labor pains after the first hour or so. That’s in no small part thanks to the flood of hormones that soon fills her brain: Sam is downright perky even as sweat drips down her face from the muscular effort. "

rows.original: She carefully squats or sits down from time to time, fairly casually, considering the circumstance, watching a video or playing a game on her tablet, but the ausar girl maintains her deep, regular breathing, and stops what she’s doing occasionally to push. Sometimes she makes conversation with you, obviously giddy with anticipation about meeting her future kid
rows.translation: 考虑到眼下的状况，她不时小心蹲下或坐下，态度颇为随意，看看视频，或在平板上玩游戏；不过这个奥萨尔女孩始终保持深沉而规律的呼吸，偶尔会停下手头的事用力生产。有时她会和你交谈，显然因即将见到自己未来的孩子
rows.raw: "\n\nShe carefully squats or sits down from time to time, fairly casually, considering the circumstance, watching a video or playing a game on her tablet, but the ausar girl maintains her deep, regular breathing, and stops what she’s doing occasionally to push. Sometimes she makes conversation with you, obviously giddy with anticipation about meeting her future kid"

rows.original: . “It kind of hurts,” she says after one of her pushes, “but it also kind of doesn’t. I actually feel like I could run a marathon. I’ve never been so wired in my life!”
rows.translation: 。“是有点痛，”她在一次用力后说道，“但又好像没那么痛。我觉得自己甚至能跑一场马拉松。我这辈子从没这么亢奋过！”

rows.original: That’s easy enough to tell, as whenever there’s a lull in her labor, Sam proceeds to talk your ear off, something you’re not entirely accustomed to from the normally reserved woman. With your help she moves through a whole range of positions as the hours pass, talking to you or playing on her tablet the entire time as she sits, stands, squats down, drops on her hands and knees, or grips the edge of the bed and rolls her hips. She works up a sheen of sweat, but the whelping ausar’s head is so full of endorphins that she acts as though she’s chatting with you over coffee.
rows.translation: 这一点再明显不过：每当阵痛稍歇，萨姆便开始在你耳边说个不停，你可不太习惯这个平日沉默寡言的女人如此健谈。几个小时过去，在你的帮助下，她换遍了各种姿势；无论坐着、站着、蹲下、四肢着地，还是抓住床沿扭动腰胯，她始终一边与你聊天，一边在平板上玩游戏。她浑身渗出一层细汗，可这个正在分娩的奥萨尔脑中充满内啡肽，表现得就像在和你喝咖啡闲聊一样轻松。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s easy enough to tell, as whenever there’s a lull in her labor, Sam proceeds to talk your ear off, something you’re not entirely accustomed to from the normally reserved woman. With your help she moves through a whole range of positions as the hours pass, talking to you or playing on her tablet the entire time as she sits, stands, squats down, drops on her hands and knees, or grips the edge of the bed and rolls her hips. While they snooze in her arms, she whispers to you, cooing in delight about whose features this baby has more of, which one of you they’ll look more like when they grow up, and every sort of thing a new mother dreams of. rows.original: The docking umbilical leads through an air-tight plasteel iris into a steel-gray, sterile corridor inside the station itself. Now that you’re inside, you can see the same thorough, threatening security practiced outside is mirrored inside Gastigoth, too. Several small-caliber gun turrets track your movements, one in every corner of the ceiling - and a couple floating half-concealed behind ducts or the single, almost comical potted plant against the far wall.
rows.translation: 对接通道穿过一道气密塑钢虹膜门，通向空间站内部一条钢灰色的无菌走廊。如今进到里面，你能看到加斯提戈斯站内部同样复制了外部那套周密而充满威胁的安保措施。数座小口径炮塔追踪着你的一举一动，天花板每个角落都有一座--还有几座漂浮在管道后方，或远端墙边那盆几乎滑稽可笑的唯一盆栽后面，半遮半掩。

rows.original: The station’s visitor lobby is the most colorful place you’ve seen so far: it has two potted plants: little bonzai trees on either end of a glass end table that’s stacked with datapads and holomags. A pair of curved silver couches surround it, giving you a place to relax while you wait... though the atmosphere is somewhat blemished by the half-dozen armed guards in full armor and jump jets standing around the north access tunnel. Sitting up against one of the walls is a large holoterminal with the words “Penal Station Services” pulsating slowly, constantly drawing your eye from anywhere in the room. Aside from the way you got here, back east, there’s a single elevator door on the western bulkhead. It’s marked “Controller’s Deck,” and has no visible access buttons.
rows.translation: 空间站的访客大厅是你迄今见过色彩最丰富的地方：这里有两盆植物，玻璃边桌两端各摆着一棵小盆景树，桌上堆满数据板和全息杂志。两张弧形银色沙发环绕着它，让你等候时有地方休息...不过，北侧通道附近站着六名身披全套护甲、配备跳跃喷射器的武装守卫，让气氛多少有些败兴。 一台大型全息终端靠墙而立，“监狱站服务”几个字正缓缓闪动，无论你身处房间何处，视线都会不断被它吸引。 除了东边你来时的道路，西侧舱壁上只有一扇电梯门。上面标着“管理层甲板”，看不到任何操作按钮。

rows.original:
The elevator opens directly into Warden Kasmiran’s office: a huge, cavernous audience chamber as much reminiscent of a medieval throne room as a modern executive’s suit. The walls are dominated by holographic security displays intermixed with handsome art-nouveau styled paintings of her fellow cylirians and their ashen homeworld. The Warden’s desk sits on a raised dias, a semi-circle of pure marble that clashes horribly with the gunmetal gray of the bulkheads and deck.

Several bonzai trees surround the edges, separating you and her seat of power with a wall of green and browns. The rest of the desk is dominated by dozens of small holoscreens, all facing inwards to the Warden’s seat, and behind her is a huge projector screen with cylirian symbols scrawling across it too fast to translate.

Unlike everywhere else in the station, you don’t have guns constantly aimed at you in here. In fact, there’s no security measure to be seen - beyond the Warden herself, an imposing figure leaning back in her chair, one leg crossed over the other. A thin cigar is clutched in her latex fingertips, wisping into the air vent directly over her head, and you cannot avoid the feeling of her golden-red cyber eyes drilling into you, unblinking and unreadable.
rows.translation:
电梯直接通入卡斯米兰典狱长的办公室：这是一间巨大而空旷的会客厅，与其说像现代高管的套房，同样也令人想起中世纪的王座厅。墙壁大半被全息安保画面占据，其间点缀着华美的新艺术风格画作，描绘她的西利里安同胞和他们灰白色的母星。典狱长的办公桌位于高台上，是一道纯大理石半圆，与舱壁和甲板的炮铜灰色显得极不协调。

数棵盆景树环绕边缘，以一堵棕绿相间的围墙将你与她的权力座席分隔开。桌面其余部分挤满了数十块小型全息屏，全都朝向典狱长的座位；她身后则是一块巨大的投影屏，西利里安符号以快得无法翻译的速度从上面划过。

与空间站其他任何地方不同，这里没有枪口始终瞄着你。事实上，除了典狱长本人，根本看不到任何安保措施。她气势逼人地靠坐在椅中，双腿交叠。裹着乳胶的指尖夹着一根细雪茄，烟雾袅袅飘入头顶正上方的通风口；你无法摆脱那种感觉：她金红色的义眼正一眨不眨、难以解读地刺入你的身体。

rows.original: The trip through the Warp Gate network back into the safety of last generation’s Rush Space is relatively easy, as far as jumps go, though it takes a bit longer than you’d like. The network out here still isn’t as robust as back in the core proper, but there’s little risk of piracy or the like. For once, you can rest easy as you travel.
rows.translation: 这次通过跃迁门网络返回上一代行星开拓区的安全地带，就跃迁而言还算轻松，尽管花的时间比你希望的稍久。这里的网络仍不如核心区域完善，但几乎没有海盗之类的风险。这一次，你终于可以在旅途中安心休息。
rows.raw: "The trip through the Warp Gate network back into the safety of last generation’s Rush Space is relatively easy, as far as jumps go, though it takes a bit longer than you’d like. The network out here still isn’t as robust as back in the core proper, but there’s little risk of piracy or the like. For once, you can rest easy as you travel."

rows.original: Several hours pass before your ship’s computer alerts you to your arrival. You yawn and roll out of bed, stretching on your way up to the bridge and flop into your captain’s chair still blinking the sleep from your eyes. It doesn’t take long for your gaze to narrow and focus, though, as your auto-pilot sweeps you towards your destination.
rows.translation: 数小时后，飞船电脑提醒你已经抵达。你打着哈欠翻身下床，前往舰桥的路上伸展身体，随后瘫进船长椅，眨着眼睛驱散睡意。不过，当自动驾驶系统带你驶向目的地时，你很快就眯起双眼，集中精神。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral hours pass before your ship’s computer alerts you to your arrival. You yawn and roll out of bed, stretching on your way up to the bridge and flop into your captain’s chair still blinking the sleep from your eyes. It doesn’t take long for your gaze to narrow and focus, though, as your auto-pilot sweeps you towards your destination."

rows.original: Gastigoth is a monster of a space station, a mammoth sphere of faceted metals ridged by communications arrays and bristling with weapons. It has no discernable top or bottom, or any other axis beyond a high tower coming from the center of the orb nearest you. Only as you approach this docking arm do you truly get a sense for the station’s scale: it is a behemoth structure that blots out the distant light of the system’s twin suns, and its docking ring alone is the size of a Terran super-carrier. In fact, you’re not convinced that isn’t exactly what it is: a long stretch of solid, flat steel which turns several batteries of rail cannon towards you as you approach, eyeing you dangerously with a hundred barrels of high-powered ship-reaping death before a beep passes over your communications array.
rows.translation: 加斯提戈斯站是一头空间站巨兽：由多面金属构成的庞大球体，通信阵列如脊骨般横贯表面，武器更是密密麻麻。它没有可辨认的顶部、底部或其他轴向，只有一座高塔从最靠近你的球体中心伸出。直到接近这条对接臂，你才真正体会到空间站的规模：这座庞然巨构遮蔽了星系遥远双恒星的光芒，仅仅一圈对接环便有一艘泰伦超级航母那么大。事实上，你甚至不敢肯定那不是由一艘航母改成的：一大片漫长而平坦的实心钢铁，在你靠近时让数组轨道炮转向你，以整整一百根能够撕碎飞船的高功率死亡炮管危险地审视着你，随后通讯阵列响起提示音。
rows.raw: "\n\nGastigoth is a monster of a space station, a mammoth sphere of faceted metals ridged by communications arrays and bristling with weapons. It has no discernable top or bottom, or any other axis beyond a high tower coming from the center of the orb nearest you. Only as you approach this docking arm do you truly get a sense for the station’s scale: it is a behemoth structure that blots out the distant light of the system’s twin suns, and its docking ring alone is the size of a Terran super-carrier. In fact, you’re not convinced that isn’t exactly what it is: a long stretch of solid, flat steel which turns several batteries of rail cannon towards you as you approach, eyeing you dangerously with a hundred barrels of high-powered ship-reaping death before a beep passes over your communications array."

rows.original: You answer quickly, not eager to make whoever’s got that much firepower antsy.
rows.translation: 你迅速接通，可不想让掌握如此强大火力的人感到不安。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou answer quickly, not eager to make whoever’s got that much firepower antsy."

rows.original: The forward viewscreen blinks out and resolves into an interior camera view. Aboard the armored dock’s bridge, you imagine, if the dozens of holoscreens and fire solution displays flickering in the background are any indication. Unsubtly, several of them show your ship in the crossed sights of heavy cannons and missile racks.
rows.translation: 前方视屏闪灭，继而显出内部摄像头画面。倘若背景中闪烁的数十块全息屏和射击解算画面能够说明什么，你猜这里是装甲码头的舰桥。画面毫不隐晦，其中几块屏幕正显示你的飞船被重炮和导弹架的十字准星牢牢套住。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe forward viewscreen blinks out and resolves into an interior camera view. Aboard the armored dock’s bridge, you imagine, if the dozens of holoscreens and fire solution displays flickering in the background are any indication. Unsubtly, several of them show your ship in the crossed sights of heavy cannons and missile racks."

rows.original: The only actual person visible on screen is a young woman, pretty as far as primly-cut military types go, though she’s got an unpleasant, emotionless expression on her face. Her hands are clasped in front of her, folded in a way that shows small patches of colorful scales underneath her white-trimmed, dark orange uniform’s sleeves - coloration mirrored on her cheeks and neck, though her face is fleshy and human. Human-reptile crossbreed of some sort?
rows.translation: 屏幕上唯一真正的人是一名年轻女人；以衣着一丝不苟的军人标准而言，她颇为漂亮，脸上却带着令人不快且毫无感情的神情。她双手交握在身前，折叠的姿势露出袖口下几小块颜色鲜艳的鳞片；她身穿白边深橙制服，脸颊和颈部也有相同色泽，不过脸庞仍是肉质的人类面孔。某种人类与爬行类的混血？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe only actual person visible on screen is a young woman, pretty as far as primly-cut military types go, though she’s got an unpleasant, emotionless expression on her face. Her hands are clasped in front of her, folded in a way that shows small patches of colorful scales underneath her white-trimmed, dark orange uniform’s sleeves - coloration mirrored on her cheeks and neck, though her face is fleshy and human. Human-reptile crossbreed of some sort?"

rows.original: She fixes you with a pair of solid, bright blue eyes slitted like a cat’s. “Attention [pc_ship.short], you have entered a Confederate-licensed security zone. You will power down all shields and weapons, and follow automatic docking trajectories into hangar...” she glances aside. “Hangar twenty-two alpha. Hmm, reserved for special guests. Regardless, any change in your weapons systems once you are within the point perimeter will be construed as an active threat and result in atomization. Understood?”
rows.translation: 一双纯粹的亮蓝眼睛盯住你，瞳孔像猫一样狭长。“注意，[pc_ship.short]，你已进入邦联许可的安全区域。关闭所有护盾和武器，沿自动对接航线驶入机库...”她瞥向一旁。“二十二号甲机库。嗯，供特殊访客使用。无论如何，进入界标范围后，武器系统发生任何变化都会被视为主动威胁，并导致你被原子化。明白吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe fixes you with a pair of solid, bright blue eyes slitted like a cat’s. “Attention [pc_ship.short], you have entered a Confederate-licensed security zone. You will power down all shields and weapons, and follow automatic docking trajectories into hangar...” she glances aside. “Hangar twenty-two alpha. Hmm, reserved for special guests. Regardless, any change in your weapons systems once you are within the point perimeter will be construed as an active threat and result in atomization. Understood?”"

rows.original: Wow, they really go all out here. Feels like you’re flying into a military base as much as you are into a maximum-security prison.
rows.translation: 哇，他们这里真是毫不马虎。与其说你正飞进一座最高戒备监狱，感觉同样也像在飞进军事基地。
rows.raw: "\n\nWow, they really go all out here. Feels like you’re flying into a military base as much as you are into a maximum-security prison."

rows.original: Considering the Nova Securities uniform the woman on-screen is wearing, you’re not sure there’s much of a difference here. Private military, private prison... You shrug off the thought and power down your ship’s combat defenses. Not that they’d do you much good if the owner of this place decided to get nasty, but losing your shields makes you feel awfully vulnerable nonetheless.
rows.translation: 考虑到屏幕上的女人穿着新星安保制服，你不确定二者在这里有多大区别。私人军队、私人监狱...你把这个念头抛到脑后，关闭飞船的战斗防御。假如这里的主人决定来硬的，那些防御大概也帮不上多少忙，但失去护盾仍令你感觉脆弱得要命。
rows.raw: "\n\nConsidering the Nova Securities uniform the woman on-screen is wearing, you’re not sure there’s much of a difference here. Private military, private prison... You shrug off the thought and power down your ship’s combat defenses. Not that they’d do you much good if the owner of this place decided to get nasty, but losing your shields makes you feel awfully vulnerable nonetheless."

rows.original: “Thank you, Captain,” the security officer says, giving you the faintest hint of a nod. “Docking tethers are interfacing with your systems... now.”
rows.translation: “谢谢配合，船长，”安保人员说道，几不可见地点了一下头。“对接牵引系统正在与你的系统连接...现在。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you, Captain,” the security officer says, giving you the faintest hint of a nod. “Docking tethers are interfacing with your systems... now.”"

rows.original: You feel a slight rumble under the deck as their computer talks to yours, cajoling your autopilot to follow a slightly different course. The system submissively adjusts, following a glowing light pattern on the almost-carrier’s deck until you’re skidding to a halt on your landing struts, hooking into an old-fashioned magnetic catapult that, rather than blasting you off, starts sucking you in towards the station interior.
rows.translation: 他们的电脑与你的系统通信时，你感到甲板下方轻轻震动，诱导自动驾驶系统沿稍有不同的航线飞行。系统顺从地调整方向，沿着这艘近似航母的舰船甲板上一道发光图案前进，直到你的飞船用起落支架滑停，挂上一台老式磁力弹射器；它没有把你发射出去，反倒开始将你吸向空间站内部。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel a slight rumble under the deck as their computer talks to yours, cajoling your autopilot to follow a slightly different course. The system submissively adjusts, following a glowing light pattern on the almost-carrier’s deck until you’re skidding to a halt on your landing struts, hooking into an old-fashioned magnetic catapult that, rather than blasting you off, starts sucking you in towards the station interior."

rows.original: “Very good,” the woman on-screen says while you’re being shuttled to your destination. “Your landing will be complete momentarily. Welcome to penal station Gastigoth, Captain Steele. We will see you soon.”
rows.translation: “很好，”你被运往目的地时，屏幕上的女人说道。“即将完成着陆。斯蒂尔船长，欢迎来到监狱站加斯提戈斯。我们很快就会见面。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very good,” the woman on-screen says while you’re being shuttled to your destination. “Your landing will be complete momentarily. Welcome to penal station Gastigoth, Captain Steele. We will see you soon.”"

rows.original: The screen cuts off sharply. Well, you can’t fault them on efficiency. A few seconds later and your hull thumps against something solid, followed by a resounding... nothing. It takes you a moment to notice that your airlock signal is blinking, telling you that a pressurized umbilical has attached. With the holocall dead, you’re free to glance out into the dock: your ship is one of about a dozen on deck, mostly expensive-looking pleasure yachts and high-performance speedsters.
rows.translation: 屏幕干脆利落地断开。好吧，你不能指责他们缺乏效率。几秒后，船壳撞上某种坚实物体，发出一声闷响，紧接着是一阵响亮的...寂静。你过了一会儿才注意到气闸信号正在闪烁，表示加压连接通道已经接合。全息通话结束后，你可以随意望向码头：甲板上停着大约十二艘飞船，你的是其中之一，其他大多是看起来价格不菲的豪华游艇和高性能快艇。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe screen cuts off sharply. Well, you can’t fault them on efficiency. A few seconds later and your hull thumps against something solid, followed by a resounding... nothing. It takes you a moment to notice that your airlock signal is blinking, telling you that a pressurized umbilical has attached. With the holocall dead, you’re free to glance out into the dock: your ship is one of about a dozen on deck, mostly expensive-looking pleasure yachts and high-performance speedsters."

rows.original: Not quite the clientele you might have expected from a fringe prison... more like a core-ward country club.
rows.translation: 这可不太像你想象中边境监狱会接待的客人...倒更像核心方向的一家乡村俱乐部。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot quite the clientele you might have expected from a fringe prison... more like a core-ward country club."

rows.original: You take a deep breath and stand up. Time to see what you’ve flown into...
rows.translation: 你深吸一口气，站起身来。该去看看自己飞进了什么地方...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a deep breath and stand up. Time to see what you’ve flown into..."

rows.original: You drop out of the local Warp Gate well outside the commanding shadow of penal station Gastigoth, yet it’s never not an imposing sight when the behemoth sphere comes rolling into view, bristling with guns and high-tech sensors. Your autopilot guides you around the sphere to the docking arm, the one unique blemish in the otherwise oblique sphere.
rows.translation: 你从本地跃迁门脱离时，位置远在监狱站加斯提戈斯投下的凌厉阴影之外；可当那颗布满武器和高科技传感器的庞大球体滚入视野时，它依然气势骇人。自动驾驶系统引导你绕过球体，飞向那条对接臂--它是这颗线条倾斜的球体表面唯一独特的瑕疵。
rows.raw: "You drop out of the local Warp Gate well outside the commanding shadow of penal station Gastigoth, yet it’s never not an imposing sight when the behemoth sphere comes rolling into view, bristling with guns and high-tech sensors. Your autopilot guides you around the sphere to the docking arm, the one unique blemish in the otherwise oblique sphere."

rows.original: As you approach, your systems alert you at once to several weapon locks and a video call. You answer, already turning off your weapons and shields.
rows.translation: 你一靠近，系统便立刻警告有数件武器锁定飞船，并收到一通视频呼叫。你接通通讯，同时已经在关闭武器和护盾。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you approach, your systems alert you at once to several weapon locks and a video call. You answer, already turning off your weapons and shields."

rows.original: “Welcome back, Captain,” the half-reptilian
rows.translation: “欢迎回来，船长，”那位半爬行类的
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome back, Captain,” the half-reptilian "

rows.translation: 前任新星安保军官
rows.raw: "Nova officer from before"

rows.original: Commander Brandt
rows.translation: 布兰特指挥官
rows.raw: "Commander Brandt"

                    : "as pleasantly as an otherwise emotionless drone can"

rows.original: a note of displeasure barely restrained under an emotionless facade
rows.translation: 毫无感情的面具下勉强压住一丝不悦
rows.raw: "a note of displeasure barely restrained under an emotionless facade"

rows.original: as pleasantly as an otherwise emotionless drone can
rows.translation: 语气愉快到了一个毫无感情的机器人所能达到的极限
rows.raw: "as pleasantly as an otherwise emotionless drone can"

rows.original: . “I see you remember our security procedures. Please keep your weapons offline and allow our docking computers to guide you onto the catapult deck.”
rows.translation: 。“看来你还记得我们的安保程序。请保持武器离线，让对接电脑引导你降落在弹射甲板上。”
rows.raw: ". “I see you remember our security procedures. Please keep your weapons offline and allow our docking computers to guide you onto the catapult deck.”"

rows.original: You do so, having little to do now but sit back in your chair and wait until the computers bump digital uglies and do their merry dance, dragging you onto the deck of the docking arm and then inside its maw. The security commander stays on the line with you, silently regarding you with her huge, near-solid-blue eyes, crisply-folded scaled hands in front of her until you’ve parked. She taps a hardlight button on her panel, extending the docking umbilical.
rows.translation: 你照办了；此时除了靠坐在椅中等待电脑互相进行数字交媾、跳起欢快舞蹈，你也无事可做。它们将你拖上对接臂的甲板，继而拉入其巨口。安保指挥官一直与你保持通讯，默默用那双巨大、近乎纯蓝的眼睛审视你，覆有鳞片的双手利落地叠在身前，直到你停稳。她轻触面板上的硬光按钮，伸出对接通道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do so, having little to do now but sit back in your chair and wait until the computers bump digital uglies and do their merry dance, dragging you onto the deck of the docking arm and then inside its maw. The security commander stays on the line with you, silently regarding you with her huge, near-solid-blue eyes, crisply-folded scaled hands in front of her until you’ve parked. She taps a hardlight button on her panel, extending the docking umbilical."

rows.original: “We’ll be awaiting you inside, Captain,” she says simply, killing the call.
rows.translation: “我们会在里面等候您，船长，”她简短说道，随即切断通讯。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ll be awaiting you inside, Captain,” she says simply, killing the call."

rows.original: Once more, it seems, you’ve managed to avoid being atomized by the stone cold lizard-woman. You let out a little breath and hop up, ready to get going.
rows.translation: 看来，你又一次避免了被那个冷若岩石的蜥蜴女人原子化。你轻轻呼出一口气，起身准备出发。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce more, it seems, you’ve managed to avoid being atomized by the stone cold lizard-woman. You let out a little breath and hop up, ready to get going."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Leaving Gastigoth
rows.translation: 离开加斯提戈斯站
rows.raw: "Leaving Gastigoth"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You plop into your captain’s chair and buzz the station’s comm channel, saying that you’re ready to depart.
rows.translation: 你一屁股坐进船长椅，接通空间站的通讯频道，表示自己已经准备离港。
rows.raw: "You plop into your captain’s chair and buzz the station’s comm channel, saying that you’re ready to depart."

rows.original: The same half-reptilian woman that guided you in the first time
rows.translation: 初次为你引航的那位半爬行类女人
rows.raw: " The same half-reptilian woman that guided you in the first time"

rows.original: Commander Brandt
rows.translation: 布兰特指挥官
rows.raw: " Commander Brandt"

rows.original: appears on your forward screen, cool and crisp in her dark uniform.
rows.translation: 出现在前方视屏上，身着深色制服，神情冷静利落。
rows.raw: " appears on your forward screen, cool and crisp in her dark uniform."

rows.original: “Understood, [pc_ship.short],” she answers evenly, depressing a holographic panel in front of her. You feel the deck underneath you shudder, then your ship start to move. “The magnetic catapult will launch your vessel beyond our security perimeter. Per regulation, do not attempt manual engine control or activate any weapons systems until you are beyond our security zone.”
rows.translation: “明白，[pc_ship.short]，”她语气平稳地回答，同时按下身前的全息面板。你感觉脚下甲板一颤，随后飞船开始移动。“磁力弹射器将把您的飞船发射至我们的安全边界之外。依照规定，在离开安全区域前，请勿尝试手动控制引擎，也不要启动任何武器系统。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Understood, [pc_ship.short],” she answers evenly, depressing a holographic panel in front of her. You feel the deck underneath you shudder, then your ship start to move. “The magnetic catapult will launch your vessel beyond our security perimeter. Per regulation, do not attempt manual engine control or activate any weapons systems until you are beyond our security zone.”"

rows.original: You’re reminded of the hundred or so railguns outside, and decide that’s mighty fine advice.
rows.translation: 你想起外面的上百门轨道炮，觉得这是极好的建议。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re reminded of the hundred or so railguns outside, and decide that’s mighty fine advice."

rows.original: A few moments later and the catapult chain under your landing gear hurls you like a big, fat brick off into space. The ship shudders around you, balking at the sudden acceleration, but the trip out of the prison’s defensive zone is relatively quick. Once you’re safe,
rows.translation: 片刻后，起落架下的弹射链像扔出一块又大又胖的砖头般，将你抛入太空。飞船在你周围震颤，抗拒着骤然增加的加速度，不过离开监狱防御区的路程相对短暂。抵达安全地带后，
rows.raw: "\n\nA few moments later and the catapult chain under your landing gear hurls you like a big, fat brick off into space. The ship shudders around you, balking at the sudden acceleration, but the trip out of the prison’s defensive zone is relatively quick. Once you’re safe,"

rows.original: the officer gives you a slight nod, and
rows.translation: 那名军官轻轻向你点头，随后
rows.raw: " the officer gives you a slight nod, and"

rows.original: Brandt gives you a slight nod, and
rows.translation: 布兰特轻轻向你点头，随后
rows.raw: " Brandt gives you a slight nod, and"

rows.original: your computer bleeps that its lost connection with Gastigoth’s.
rows.translation: 你的电脑发出提示音，表示它已与加斯提戈斯站的系统断开连接。
rows.raw: " your computer bleeps that its lost connection with Gastigoth’s."

rows.original: “Safe travels, Captain,” the Nova officer says crisply.
rows.translation: “一路平安，船长，”那名新星安保军官干练地说道。
rows.raw: "“Safe travels, Captain,” the Nova officer says crisply. "

rows.original: The call cuts off, leaving you to take a heavy breath and look towards your next destination.
rows.translation: 通讯断开，只剩你深深吸一口气，望向下一个目的地。
rows.raw: "The call cuts off, leaving you to take a heavy breath and look towards your next destination."

rows.original: Just in case, your shields come back on the moment you’re out of range.
rows.translation: 为防万一，刚一离开射程，你便重新开启护盾。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust in case, your shields come back on the moment you’re out of range."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: The message is clear enough: you step up to the small, gunmetal desk between you and the woman you’d spoken to over comms. Now that you’re in the same room, you can really get the size of her: she’s handsome, in a serious and grim-faced way, overly tall for a human and athletically built. She’s six-five, you’d guess, though that might be helped by the over-sized combat boots she’s wearing, complete with magnetized armor and jump jets, and she’s sleekly muscular beneath the dark orange dress uniform she’s got on. A boxer’s build, you think to yourself, though of course you’d need to see under that uniform to really gauge her physique.
rows.translation: 她的意思再清楚不过：你走向那张隔在自己与通讯中交谈过的女人之间的小型炮铜色桌子。如今身处同一房间，你才真正意识到她的体格：她有一种严肃冷峻的俊朗，远比寻常人类高大，身材强健。你估计她有六英尺五英寸，不过那双硕大的战斗靴可能也帮了忙；靴子配有磁化装甲和跳跃喷射器，而深橙色礼服下则是一具修长结实的身体。你觉得那是拳击手般的体格，当然，要真正判断她的身材，还得看看制服底下才行。
rows.raw: "The message is clear enough: you step up to the small, gunmetal desk between you and the woman you’d spoken to over comms. Now that you’re in the same room, you can really get the size of her: she’s handsome, in a serious and grim-faced way, overly tall for a human and athletically built. She’s six-five, you’d guess, though that might be helped by the over-sized combat boots she’s wearing, complete with magnetized armor and jump jets, and she’s sleekly muscular beneath the dark orange dress uniform she’s got on. A boxer’s build, you think to yourself, though of course you’d need to see under that uniform to really gauge her physique."

rows.original: Still, what you can see is appealing: flawless golden-bronze skin on a fundamentally human body shape, though she’s got small patches of yellowish scales on the sides of her neck and completely encasing her bare hands. Reddish blonde hair complements her coloration, pulled back into a tight military bun behind a pair of unadorned, small ears. Her eyes, though, are huge and solid blue, save for a pair of vertical slits that regard you coolly.
rows.translation: 不过，眼下能看到的部分已经很有吸引力：以人类身体为基础，皮肤光滑无瑕，呈金铜色；颈部两侧有小片淡黄色鳞片，裸露的双手更是完全被鳞片包裹。红金色头发与肤色相得益彰，在一双朴素的小耳朵后方扎成紧实的军用发髻。至于她的双眼，则又大又纯蓝，只有一对竖直的细缝冷冷审视着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, what you can see is appealing: flawless golden-bronze skin on a fundamentally human body shape, though she’s got small patches of yellowish scales on the sides of her neck and completely encasing her bare hands. Reddish blonde hair complements her coloration, pulled back into a tight military bun behind a pair of unadorned, small ears. Her eyes, though, are huge and solid blue, save for a pair of vertical slits that regard you coolly."

rows.original: And, you notice, she’s got a thick tail sprouting from the back of her uniform, dragging heavily on the floor like a still lump of solid muscle - it’s yellow like her scales, though a somewhat darker hue. Almost gold.
rows.translation: 而且你注意到，她的制服背后伸出一条粗壮尾巴，沉重地拖在地面上，仿佛一块一动不动的结实肌肉--颜色和鳞片一样黄，只是色调略深，近乎金色。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd, you notice, she’s got a thick tail sprouting from the back of her uniform, dragging heavily on the floor like a still lump of solid muscle - it’s yellow like her scales, though a somewhat darker hue. Almost gold. "

rows.original: Ovir
rows.raw: "Ovir"

rows.original: You’d guess she’s half-ovir now that you can see the tail. Wonder what she’s got under the belt, if that’s the case.
rows.translation: 如今看到这条尾巴，你猜她是半奥维尔人。不知道既然如此，她腰带下面长着什么。
rows.raw: "You’d guess she’s half-ovir now that you can see the tail. Wonder what she’s got under the belt, if that’s the case."

rows.original: Your Codex beeps an alert that it’s detected a new race: the ovir. The officer cocks an eyebrow at the audible alert, maybe surprised you’ve never met a core race like hers. Good going, Codex.
rows.translation: 你的终端发出警报，表示检测到一个新种族：奥维尔。听见提示音，那名军官挑起眉毛，或许很惊讶你从未见过她这样的核心种族。干得好，终端。
rows.raw: "Your Codex beeps an alert that it’s detected a new race: the ovir. The officer cocks an eyebrow at the audible alert, maybe surprised you’ve never met a core race like hers. Good going, Codex."

rows.original: “Captain,” she says after a long moment, shifting her weight slightly. You blink, suddenly aware you were
rows.translation: “船长，”漫长片刻后，她稍稍移动重心，开口说道。你眨眨眼，突然意识到自己刚才一直在
rows.raw: "\n\n“Captain,” she says after a long moment, shifting her weight slightly. You blink, suddenly aware you were "

rows.original: casually undressing her with your eyes... while she was looking right back at you
rows.translation: 若无其事地用目光脱掉她的衣服...而她始终回望着你
rows.raw: "casually undressing her with your eyes... while she was looking right back at you"

rows.original: staring
rows.translation: 盯着她看
rows.raw: "staring"

rows.original: . “Welcome to Gastigoth. I am Sub-Commander Brandt, and I will be your escort for the moment. Before you go any further into the station, though, I am afraid I have to ask you to disarm.”
rows.translation: 。“欢迎来到加斯提戈斯站。我是布兰特副指挥官，暂时由我为你引路。不过在你继续深入空间站前，恐怕我必须请你解除武装。”
rows.raw: ". “Welcome to Gastigoth. I am Sub-Commander Brandt, and I will be your escort for the moment. Before you go any further into the station, though, I am afraid I have to ask you to disarm.”"

rows.original: Well, that’s hardly unexpected considering the way she emasculated your ship earlier. You sigh and, very slowly, start to withdraw your equipment. Brandt gives you a slight nod, but otherwise remains motionless as you dump your kit into a plastic tub sitting on the table.
rows.translation: 考虑到她刚才如何阉割了你的飞船，这一点毫不意外。你叹了口气，非常缓慢地开始取下装备。布兰特轻轻点头，除此之外始终纹丝不动，看着你将装备倾倒进桌上的塑料桶。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that’s hardly unexpected considering the way she emasculated your ship earlier. You sigh and, very slowly, start to withdraw your equipment. Brandt gives you a slight nod, but otherwise remains motionless as you dump your kit into a plastic tub sitting on the table."

rows.original: Once you’re done, she slides the bucket aside with a practiced motion and picks up a wand-like device off her belt. The half-ovir waves you forward with two fingers, drawing you around the desk until you’re an arm’s breadth from her - at that point, her fingers depress solidly into your chest, stopping you on a dime while her other hand waves the wand over your person.
rows.translation: 完成后，她以熟练的动作把桶滑到一旁，从腰带上取下一根棒状装置。这个半奥维尔女人用两根手指示意你上前，把你引到桌子另一侧，直到你离她只有一臂之遥--此时她的手指有力地按在你胸口，让你当即停下，另一只手则用棒状装置扫描你的全身。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’re done, she slides the bucket aside with a practiced motion and picks up a wand-like device off her belt. The half-ovir waves you forward with two fingers, drawing you around the desk until you’re an arm’s breadth from her - at that point, her fingers depress solidly into your chest, stopping you on a dime while her other hand waves the wand over your person."

rows.original: “Hmm. Clear,” she says, and you’re half certain you hear a tiny hint of surprise in her voice. The closest thing she’s shown to emotion since your arrival. “Very well. As I said, welcome to the penal station, Captain Steele. The Warden has been alerted to your arrival and should be on her way. She insisted you were an important visit. The lobby is one turn north, then another westward along the station’s axis. Feel free to wait for her there. If, however, you have any questions...”
rows.translation: “嗯。安全，”她说道，你几乎确信自己从她的声音中听见了一丝惊讶。这是你抵达后，她表现出的最接近情绪的东西。“很好。如我所说，斯蒂尔船长，欢迎来到监狱站。典狱长已经得知您抵达，应该正在过来。她坚称您是一位重要访客。大厅在北边第一个转角处，然后沿空间站轴线向西再转一次。您可以在那里等候她。不过，如果您有什么问题...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm. Clear,” she says, and you’re half certain you hear a tiny hint of surprise in her voice. The closest thing she’s shown to emotion since your arrival. “Very well. As I said, welcome to the penal station, Captain Steele. The Warden has been alerted to your arrival and should be on her way. She insisted you were an important visit. The lobby is one turn north, then another westward along the station’s axis. Feel free to wait for her there. If, however, you have any questions...”"

rows.original: “Brandt,” you say, stepping up to the security station.
rows.translation: “布兰特，”你走向安检台，说道。
rows.raw: "“Brandt,” you say, stepping up to the security station."

rows.original: “Steele,” she echoes, inclining her bronze brow ever so slightly.
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔，”她重复道，金铜色眉毛略微扬起。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele,” she echoes, inclining her bronze brow ever so slightly."

rows.original: “Ready to leave?”
rows.translation: “准备离开了？”
rows.raw: " “Ready to leave?”"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: “Leaving so soon?”
rows.translation: “这么快就要走？”
rows.raw: " “Leaving so soon?”"

rows.original: “Welcome back, Captain. A pleasure to see you again.”
rows.translation: “欢迎回来，船长。很高兴再次见到您。”
rows.raw: " “Welcome back, Captain. A pleasure to see you again.”"

rows.original: “Ready to leave, Captain?”
rows.translation: “准备离开了吗，船长？”
rows.raw: " “Ready to leave, Captain?”"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: Rearm
rows.translation: 重新武装
rows.raw: "Rearm"

rows.original: Rearm
rows.translation: 重新武装
rows.raw: "Rearm"

rows.original: Get your weapons checked out.
rows.translation: 取回你寄存的武器。
rows.raw: "Get your weapons checked out."

rows.original: Disarm
rows.translation: 解除武装
rows.raw: "Disarm"

rows.original: Disarm
rows.translation: 解除武装
rows.raw: "Disarm"

rows.original: Get your weapons checked in.
rows.translation: 寄存你的武器。
rows.raw: "Get your weapons checked in."

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 查看外观
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Sub-Commander
rows.translation: 副指挥官
rows.raw: "Sub-Commander "

rows.original: Hélla
rows.translation: 赫拉
rows.raw: "Hélla "

rows.original: Brandt is a human-ovir crossbreed. Though she’s wearing the dress uniform of Nova Securities - dark orange trimmed with silvery white - there’s enough definition underneath the heavy fabric to tell you that she’s got the build of a boxer, sleek and muscular, complemented by pert B-cups and wide, egg-bearing hips beneath a toned belly.
rows.translation: 布兰特是人类与奥维尔人的混血。尽管她穿着新星安保的礼服--银白滚边的深橙制服--厚重布料下仍透出足够清晰的线条，让你看出她有一副拳击手般修长而结实的体格；紧致的B罩杯乳房和宽阔、适合产卵的腰胯则衬托着平坦健美的小腹。
rows.raw: "Brandt is a human-ovir crossbreed. Though she’s wearing the dress uniform of Nova Securities - dark orange trimmed with silvery white - there’s enough definition underneath the heavy fabric to tell you that she’s got the build of a boxer, sleek and muscular, complemented by pert B-cups and wide, egg-bearing hips beneath a toned belly."

rows.original: Most of her body is covered with golden-bronze skin, covered in just enough sweat and oil from her steamy duty in the computer-laden command room to glisten in the station’s light. Her hands, neck, lower ribs, and of course, her tail are all covered in dark yellow scales, so fine that they look almost like a single, contiguous plate at first glance. A few additional spots appear on her upper thighs and rump, almost like freckles, as well as a colorful crest of dark orange ones that dive down between her breasts. Brandt’s hairless everywhere save the top of her head, with golden-red tresses cut fairly short and pulled back into a neat military-style bun.
rows.translation: 她身体大部分覆盖着金铜色肌肤，在遍布电脑的指挥室中闷热值勤留下恰到好处的汗水和油光，令其在空间站灯光下熠熠生辉。她的双手、颈部、下方肋骨，当然还有尾巴，全都覆着深黄色鳞片；鳞片细密无比，乍看几乎像一整块连续的甲板。大腿上部和臀部还散落着一些额外斑点，几乎像雀斑；另有一道鲜艳的深橙鳞脊向下潜入双乳之间。除了头顶，布兰特全身无毛；金红发丝剪得颇短，在脑后整齐扎成军用发髻。
rows.raw: "\n\nMost of her body is covered with golden-bronze skin, covered in just enough sweat and oil from her steamy duty in the computer-laden command room to glisten in the station’s light. Her hands, neck, lower ribs, and of course, her tail are all covered in dark yellow scales, so fine that they look almost like a single, contiguous plate at first glance. A few additional spots appear on her upper thighs and rump, almost like freckles, as well as a colorful crest of dark orange ones that dive down between her breasts. Brandt’s hairless everywhere save the top of her head, with golden-red tresses cut fairly short and pulled back into a neat military-style bun."

rows.original: Her eyes are her most attention-drawing trait, huge by human standards and solidly dark blue in coloration: she lacks whites at all, merely orbs of sapphire split by slitted irises. The rest of her face seems ever so slightly mis-proportioned around them: she’s bearing a small nose, rounded human ears, and lips so slender they almost vanish into her perpetual even frown. She’s not ugly by any means, you think, but you don’t know that you’d call her beautiful, either. Handsome, maybe?
rows.translation: 她的双眼是最引人注目的特征，以人类标准而言异常巨大，色泽纯粹深蓝：眼中完全没有眼白，只有被细长瞳孔劈开的两颗蓝宝石球体。脸上其余部位围绕这双眼睛显得比例略有失调：她鼻子小巧，耳朵是圆润的人类形状，嘴唇纤细得几乎消失在一贯平静的皱眉表情中。你觉得她绝不算丑，却也说不上漂亮。也许该说英俊？
rows.raw: "\n\nHer eyes are her most attention-drawing trait, huge by human standards and solidly dark blue in coloration: she lacks whites at all, merely orbs of sapphire split by slitted irises. The rest of her face seems ever so slightly mis-proportioned around them: she’s bearing a small nose, rounded human ears, and lips so slender they almost vanish into her perpetual even frown. She’s not ugly by any means, you think, but you don’t know that you’d call her beautiful, either. Handsome, maybe?"

rows.original: A thick, heavy tail hangs behind her, peeking out of a sewn-in gap in her uniform’s dress pants. On the rare occasion you’re able to catch a glimpse of her back, you’re almost sure you see the faintest hint of pink cloth underneath, hugging her tail tightly.
rows.translation: 一条粗壮沉重的尾巴垂在身后，从制服长裤专门缝出的开口中探出。偶尔瞥见她背面时，你几乎确信自己看到了一丝极淡的粉色布料，紧紧包裹着她的尾巴。

rows.original: The half-ovir makes a noncommittal sound and folds her hands over her stomach. “I’d prefer not to gossip, captain. Warden Kasmiran has made herself available to you directly, if you’d care to come aboard. She is, I understand, eager to meet you.”
rows.translation: 这个半奥维尔女人发出不置可否的声音，双手交叠在腹前。“我不愿说人闲话，船长。如果您愿意登站，卡斯米兰典狱长已经安排与您直接见面。据我所知，她很想见您。”

rows.original: Warden Regina Kasmiran: feminized cylirian, age fifty eight. Natural-born citizen of the Terran-Space Coalition, first generation. Heavily cyberized, both necessary and voluntary. Doctorate in criminal psychology obtained from the Neue Rhineland University on the Terran colony of Carima Three, with honors. Service in the Coalition Intelligence Agency, also with honors. Currently the junior of two executive officers in control of Faangnis Corrections, having obtained a minority stock control through private brokerage before taking the position immediately after exiting Terran service.”
rows.translation: 卡斯米兰典狱长，全名蕾吉娜·卡斯米兰：女性化西利里安人，五十八岁。泰伦空间联盟第一代本土公民。高度义体化，兼具必要与自愿改造。于泰伦殖民地卡里马三号的新莱茵兰大学获得犯罪心理学博士学位，并以优异成绩毕业。曾在联盟情报局服役，同样获授荣誉。目前是控制方尼斯惩教公司的两名执行官中资历较浅的一位；她通过私人经纪取得少数股权控制，并在退出泰伦公职后立即就任。”
rows.raw: "Warden Regina Kasmiran: feminized cylirian, age fifty eight. Natural-born citizen of the Terran-Space Coalition, first generation. Heavily cyberized, both necessary and voluntary. Doctorate in criminal psychology obtained from the Neue Rhineland University on the Terran colony of Carima Three, with honors. Service in the Coalition Intelligence Agency, also with honors. Currently the junior of two executive officers in control of Faangnis Corrections, having obtained a minority stock control through private brokerage before taking the position immediately after exiting Terran service.”"

rows.original: Those sure were a lot of words that didn’t actually tell you anything about her.

rows.raw: "\n\nThose sure were a lot of words that didn’t actually tell you anything about her."

rows.original: Brandt blinks, then spends a moment thinking. “The Warden is a very... calculating individual. Profit-driven. Decisive. What some might label controlling, perhaps even dominating. But dedicated to the correction of criminal behavior with a zeal that I find commendable.”
rows.translation: 布兰特眨眨眼，思索片刻。“典狱长是个非常...精于算计的人。重视利润。行事果断。有人或许会说她控制欲强，甚至富有支配欲。但她怀着一种令我钦佩的热忱，致力于矫正犯罪行为。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt blinks, then spends a moment thinking. “The Warden is a very... calculating individual. Profit-driven. Decisive. What some might label controlling, perhaps even dominating. But dedicated to the correction of criminal behavior with a zeal that I find commendable.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nThe icy woman in front of you actually giggles at that, a momentary break from decorum that she quickly hides behind a hand. “Yes... I suppose that’s an apt description.”"

rows.translation: 布兰特则只是眨眼看着你。“我...对不起，船长，您说什么？”你走近时，她尖声问道，嗓音彻底破了调。“那不是我能自己简单决定的事...”

rows.original: One of them gives a tiny nod towards the hallway, towards Brandt’s office. The other gives her a thumb’s up around his - her? Who knows - shield.
rows.translation: 其中一人朝走廊、也就是布兰特办公室的方向微微点头。另一人则从盾牌旁伸出拇指--他的，还是她的？谁知道--冲她比了个赞。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of them gives a tiny nod towards the hallway, towards Brandt’s office. The other gives her a thumb’s up around his - her? Who knows - shield."

rows.original: Brandt gulps, then turns back to you. The same guard gives you a bigger thumbs up once the officer isn’t looking. “I... Ah. If you would like, Captain, I would be delighted to give you a tour of the station’s security command. What you might call my office. I believe you would like to see it. With me.”
rows.translation: 布兰特咽了口唾沫，转回来看你。趁军官没有看见，同一名守卫又冲你比了个更明显的赞。“我...啊。如果您愿意，船长，我很乐意带您参观空间站的安保指挥部。也就是您或许会称作我办公室的地方。我相信您会喜欢看看那里。和我一起。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt gulps, then turns back to you. The same guard gives you a bigger thumbs up once the officer isn’t looking. “I... Ah. If you would like, Captain, I would be delighted to give you a tour of the station’s security command. What you might call my office. I believe you would like to see it. With me.”"

rows.raw: "Brandt sighs as you explain yourself, slowly relaxing her shoulders when you insist that it was an innocent line of questioning."

rows.original: “I... I am sorry, Captain. I did not mean to snap,” she murmurs after a long moment, wrapping her tail around her leg. “As I said, I am not much of a conversationalist. Being asked personal questions like that is... difficult. Please, let’s discuss something else?”
rows.translation: “我...对不起，船长。我不是有意发火，”漫长片刻后，她低声说道，把尾巴缠在腿上。“正如我所说，我不太擅长与人交谈。被人问及这种私人问题...让我很难应对。拜托，我们谈点别的好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... I am sorry, Captain. I did not mean to snap,” she murmurs after a long moment, wrapping her tail around her leg. “As I said, I am not much of a conversationalist. Being asked personal questions like that is... difficult. Please, let’s discuss something else?”"

rows.translation: “...我明白了，”布兰特盯着你那副放肆的笑容说道。“是我弄错了，船长。我刚才竟一度把空间站的一名客户误认成了值得交谈的人。现在，还有其他事吗？”
rows.raw: "“...I see,” Brandt says, staring down your cheeky grin. “My mistake, Captain, I momentarily took one of the station’s clients for someone worth talking to. Now, if there’s anything else?”"
