rows.original: “So... how’d you end up working out here?” you ask, trying to find some little crack to break the ice in the officer’s otherwise stony exterior.
rows.translation: “那么...你是怎么来这里工作的？”你问道，试图在这名军官一贯冷硬的外壳上找到一道小裂缝，打破僵局。
rows.raw: "“So... how’d you end up working out here?” you ask, trying to find some little crack to break the ice in the officer’s otherwise stony exterior."

rows.original: She blinks her big, blue eyes at you, and stays silent for a moment. When she answers, it’s measured and slow. “I am a contractor for Nova Securities. As a daughter company, Faangnis Correction draws much of its security personnel from Nova.”
rows.translation: 她睁着蓝色大眼睛看你，沉默片刻。回答时，语调克制而缓慢。“我是新星安保的承包人员。作为旗下公司，方尼斯惩教公司的安保人员大多由新星提供。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe blinks her big, blue eyes at you, and stays silent for a moment. When she answers, it’s measured and slow. “I am a contractor for Nova Securities. As a daughter company, Faangnis Correction draws much of its security personnel from Nova.”"

rows.original: She inclines her head slightly towards the two towering, armored humanoids standing nearby. One of them grunts “Sup?” at you.
rows.translation: 她朝附近两名高大、身披装甲的人形生物微微偏头。其中一人冲你哼了声“咋了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe inclines her head slightly towards the two towering, armored humanoids standing nearby. One of them grunts “Sup?” at you."

rows.original: Oh. Well then, how’d she come to work for Nova?
rows.translation: 哦。好吧，那她又是怎么进新星工作的？
rows.raw: "\n\nOh. Well then, how’d she come to work for Nova?"

rows.original: She considers you for a moment more, then takes a little breath. The stone drops out of her voice, at least somewhat, as she answers. “I completed my tour of duty in the Terran navy three years ago. As I have military-grade Reaper implants, which have little purpose outside of commanding a capital warship, I am legally classified as a weapon. This, you can imagine, limits my employment options. I chose to work in private security rather than have my cybernetics removed.”
rows.translation: 她又打量你片刻，随后轻轻吸气。至少在一定程度上，她的声音不再那么冷硬。“三年前，我在泰伦海军完成了服役期。由于我装有军用级收割者植入体，而这类植入体除了指挥主力战舰外几乎没有其他用途，因此法律上将我归类为武器。你可以想象，这限制了我的就业选择。我选择进入私人安保行业，而不是移除义体。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe considers you for a moment more, then takes a little breath. The stone drops out of her voice, at least somewhat, as she answers. “I completed my tour of duty in the Terran navy three years ago. As I have military-grade Reaper implants, which have little purpose outside of commanding a capital warship, I am legally classified as a weapon. This, you can imagine, limits my employment options. I chose to work in private security rather than have my cybernetics removed.”"

rows.original: So she captained a warship? She looks a little young to have been that high-ranked.
rows.translation: 所以她曾是战舰舰长？她看起来有点太年轻，不像到过那么高的军阶。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo she captained a warship? She looks a little young to have been that high-ranked."

rows.original: “I was a Link Helmsman,” she answers evenly. “Which is to say, cybernetically attached to a ship, allowing for speed-of-thought combat reaction. I was linked to the fleet carrier Digenes Akritas for one year, and then the Volsung for an additional three as its primary Link.”
rows.translation: “我是链接舵手，”她平静回答。“也就是说，我通过义体与飞船相连，从而以思维速度作出战斗反应。我曾与舰队航母迪杰尼斯·阿克里塔斯号链接一年，随后又作为首席链接舵手，与沃尔松号链接三年。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was a Link Helmsman,” she answers evenly. “Which is to say, cybernetically attached to a ship, allowing for speed-of-thought combat reaction. I was linked to the fleet carrier Digenes Akritas for one year, and then the Volsung for an additional three as its primary Link.”"

rows.original: Hey, you’ve heard of those. They’re huge warships - prides of the Terran navy. In other words, she drove two of the biggest and scariest starships in the galaxy with her brain?
rows.translation: 嘿，你听说过那些战舰。它们是巨大的战舰--泰伦海军的骄傲。换句话说，她用自己的大脑驾驶过银河系中两艘最大、最吓人的星舰？
rows.raw: "\n\nHey, you’ve heard of those. They’re huge warships - prides of the Terran navy. In other words, she drove two of the biggest and scariest starships in the galaxy with her brain?"

rows.original: “In essence,” Brandt says, giving you a hint of a nod. “Much of my accomplishment is derived from implants, as I said, though I was given the opportunity to have them as my natural reaction speed and spatial-mathematics are in the 99th percentile for Terran soldiers.”
rows.translation: “本质上如此，”布兰特略微点头说道。“如我所说，我的大部分成就都源于植入体；不过，我能获得植入资格，是因为自己的自然反应速度与空间数学能力位于泰伦军人的第九十九百分位。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In essence,” Brandt says, giving you a hint of a nod. “Much of my accomplishment is derived from implants, as I said, though I was given the opportunity to have them as my natural reaction speed and spatial-mathematics are in the 99th percentile for Terran soldiers.”"

rows.original: Deadpan she may be, but you think you just caught Brandt bragging a little. Must be nice, being a stone-cold genius ace pilot.
rows.translation: 她或许面无表情，但你觉得自己刚才逮到布兰特小小地炫耀了一番。做个冷酷的天才王牌驾驶员，感觉一定很棒。
rows.raw: "\n\nDeadpan she may be, but you think you just caught Brandt bragging a little. Must be nice, being a stone-cold genius ace pilot."

rows.original: For once, Brandt lets herself give off a hint of a smile. “I’m afraid, as a Link Helm, I’m still four capital kills short of an ace. But... yes, I am quite satisfied with my experience nevertheless.”
rows.translation: 这一次，布兰特终于让自己露出一丝微笑。“恐怕作为链接舵手，我还差四艘主力舰击杀才能成为王牌。不过...是的，我仍然相当满意自己的经历。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFor once, Brandt lets herself give off a hint of a smile. “I’m afraid, as a Link Helm, I’m still four capital kills short of an ace. But... yes, I am quite satisfied with my experience nevertheless.”"

rows.original: Her smile widens, and she cocks her head to the side with a tick of her enormous eyes you’d almost go ahead and call cute.
rows.translation: 她笑意渐浓，头向一旁歪去，那双巨眼轻轻一动，你差点就想称之为可爱。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer smile widens, and she cocks her head to the side with a tick of her enormous eyes you’d almost go ahead and call cute."

rows.original: ... wait, does that mean she blew up a capital ship? Holy shit.
rows.translation: ...等等，这意味着她炸毁过一艘主力舰？我操。
rows.raw: "\n\n... wait, does that mean she blew up a capital ship? Holy shit."

rows.original: Herself
rows.raw: "Herself"

rows.original: “So, aside from being a, uh, ‘Link Helm,’” you say, glancing at the once-more stone-faced officer in front of you. “What else have you done?”
rows.translation: “那么，除了当一个，呃，‘链接舵手’以外，”你瞥向眼前又恢复冷峻神情的军官，说道。“你还做过什么？”
rows.raw: "“So, aside from being a, uh, ‘Link Helm,’” you say, glancing at the once-more stone-faced officer in front of you. “What else have you done?”"

rows.original: Brandt answers crisply. “I have few accomplishments outside of my military and security experience, Captain. I enlisted in the Terran navy at eighteen and have served in a green-collar function continuously since.”
rows.translation: 布兰特干练地回答。“除了军事和安保经历外，我几乎没有其他成就，船长。我十八岁加入泰伦海军，此后一直从事绿领职能。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt answers crisply. “I have few accomplishments outside of my military and security experience, Captain. I enlisted in the Terran navy at eighteen and have served in a green-collar function continuously since.”"

rows.original: Alright... well, how about before then? Where’d she grow up?
rows.translation: 好吧...那么更早以前呢？她在哪里长大？
rows.raw: "\n\nAlright... well, how about before then? Where’d she grow up?"

rows.original: “I fail to see how this is relevant to my qualifications, Captain,” she responds, shifting her weight back on her tail. You cross your arms and tell her this isn’t a job interview - you just want to talk to her.
rows.translation: “我看不出这与我的资历有何关系，船长，”她回答，身体后移，将重量压在尾巴上。你双臂抱胸，告诉她这不是求职面试--你只是想和她聊聊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I fail to see how this is relevant to my qualifications, Captain,” she responds, shifting her weight back on her tail. You cross your arms and tell her this isn’t a job interview - you just want to talk to her."

rows.original: Brandt’s nose scrunches in the shadow of her over-sized eyes, but she recomposes herself a moment later. <i>“Very well...
rows.translation: 布兰特那双过分巨大的眼睛下方，鼻子皱了起来，不过片刻后她又恢复镇定。<i>“好吧...
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt’s nose scrunches in the shadow of her over-sized eyes, but she recomposes herself a moment later. <i>“Very well... "

rows.original: I suppose there’s no harm in sharing a little more...
rows.translation: 我想，多透露一点也无妨...
rows.raw: "I suppose there’s no harm in sharing a little more..."

rows.original: if you wish for me to bore you with my personal details, I have nothing to hide.
rows.translation: 如果您希望我用个人琐事让您感到无聊，那我也没什么可隐瞒的。
rows.raw: "if you wish for me to bore you with my personal details, I have nothing to hide."

rows.original: You motion for her to go on. It’s like pulling teeth with this woman!
rows.translation: 你示意她继续。和这个女人聊天简直像拔牙一样费劲！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou motion for her to go on. It’s like pulling teeth with this woman!"

rows.original: After a moment’s thought on the matter, Brandt folds her hands behind her back and starts talking in a slow, even cadence. “I was born on Mars. My mother, the human contributor to my genetics, was and is a collegiate professor of chemistry, of Austrian descent. My ovir sire is an artist, born and raised in human colonies. One of her paintings is currently on display at the Neo Pompidou, and another in the National Gallery of Vesperia,” she adds with a hint of pride.
rows.translation: 布兰特思考片刻，将双手背到身后，以缓慢平稳的节奏讲述起来。“我出生在火星。我的母亲，也就是为我贡献人类基因的一方，是一名奥地利裔大学化学教授，过去是，现在也是。我的奥维尔血亲是一名艺术家，在人类殖民地出生长大。她的一幅画目前陈列在新蓬皮杜美术馆，另一幅则在维斯佩里亚国家美术馆展出，”她略带自豪地补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment’s thought on the matter, Brandt folds her hands behind her back and starts talking in a slow, even cadence. “I was born on Mars. My mother, the human contributor to my genetics, was and is a collegiate professor of chemistry, of Austrian descent. My ovir sire is an artist, born and raised in human colonies. One of her paintings is currently on display at the Neo Pompidou, and another in the National Gallery of Vesperia,” she adds with a hint of pride."

rows.original: Quite the accomplished family, then.
rows.translation: 这么说，她出身于一个颇有成就的家庭。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuite the accomplished family, then."

rows.original: She nods. “Yes, and luckily their careers meant they were spared the worst of the Martian depression. I was decidedly middle class, somewhat sheltered, but well loved. An only child, as you might expect. I believe my parents did a better than average job, especially given the economic conditions and lingering social stigma against non-humans in the Martian colonies.”
rows.translation: 她点头。“是的，幸运的是，她们的职业让她们避开了火星经济萧条最糟糕的部分。我的家庭无疑属于中产阶级，我受到了一定保护，也备受疼爱。如你所料，我是独生女。我认为父母的养育远高于平均水准，尤其考虑到当时的经济状况，以及火星殖民地对非人类仍然存在的社会污名。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods. “Yes, and luckily their careers meant they were spared the worst of the Martian depression. I was decidedly middle class, somewhat sheltered, but well loved. An only child, as you might expect. I believe my parents did a better than average job, especially given the economic conditions and lingering social stigma against non-humans in the Martian colonies.”"

rows.original: Brandt certainly has a... clinical diagnosis of her early life.
rows.translation: 布兰特对自己的早年生活还真有一套...临床诊断。
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt certainly has a... clinical diagnosis of her early life."

rows.original: She gives you one of those rare half-smiles. “My implants. It isn’t my intention to be... cold. This is simply the way my brain has been mechanically rewired and reconditioned. Sentimentality does not come easy to me. Nor does... small talk, as you may have gathered.”
rows.translation: 她露出那种少见的淡淡微笑。“是我的植入体。我并非有意表现得...冷漠。只是我的大脑已经被机械性地重新布线与调节。感情用事对我而言并不容易。还有...闲聊，想必你已经看出来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you one of those rare half-smiles. “My implants. It isn’t my intention to be... cold. This is simply the way my brain has been mechanically rewired and reconditioned. Sentimentality does not come easy to me. Nor does... small talk, as you may have gathered.”"

rows.original: Alright, then, maybe she’d rather talk about how she ended up joining the navy? That doesn’t seem like a natural choice for someone with her upbringing.
rows.translation: 好吧，那么她是否更愿意谈谈自己后来为什么加入海军？以她的成长环境而言，这似乎并不是顺理成章的选择。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlright, then, maybe she’d rather talk about how she ended up joining the navy? That doesn’t seem like a natural choice for someone with her upbringing."

rows.original: “Actually, I am a seventh generation veteran,” she smirks. “On my sire’s side, both in the Confederate and Terran-Space militaries. I am the first to attempt, and gain, an officer’s commission. Largely thanks to my mathematical achievements, I was able to attain a scholarship to the Martian Naval Academy. Though I did not qualify for my own command, my acceptance in the Link program assured me a place of great responsibility on any ship I chose.”
rows.translation: “事实上，我是第七代军人，”她笑道。“我的奥维尔血亲一方世代在邦联和泰伦空间军队中服役。我是第一个尝试并获得军官任命的人。主要凭借数学方面的成就，我取得奖学金，进入火星海军学院。尽管没能取得独立指挥资格，但被链接计划录取，确保我在自己选择的任何飞船上都能身居重任。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Actually, I am a seventh generation veteran,” she smirks. “On my sire’s side, both in the Confederate and Terran-Space militaries. I am the first to attempt, and gain, an officer’s commission. Largely thanks to my mathematical achievements, I was able to attain a scholarship to the Martian Naval Academy. Though I did not qualify for my own command, my acceptance in the Link program assured me a place of great responsibility on any ship I chose.”"

rows.original: Speaking of which, since she’s (inevitably gotten) on the topic again... didn’t she also say something about not wanting to get the implants out? Why’s that?
rows.translation: 说到这里，既然她又不可避免地谈到这个话题...她是不是还说过，不想移除植入体？为什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nSpeaking of which, since she’s (inevitably gotten) on the topic again... didn’t she also say something about not wanting to get the implants out? Why’s that?"

rows.original: Brandt considers you for a long moment. “If I told you that, by removing a hemisphere of your brain, I could make you happier... would you do it?”
rows.translation: 布兰特长久地打量着你。“如果我告诉你，切除一侧大脑半球就能让你更快乐...你会接受吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt considers you for a long moment. “If I told you that, by removing a hemisphere of your brain, I could make you happier... would you do it?”"

rows.original: Dude, totally.
rows.translation: 老兄，当然。
rows.raw: "\n\nDude, totally."

rows.original: Like, been there, done that!
rows.translation: 拜托，这种事早就经历过了！
rows.raw: "\n\nLike, been there, done that!"

rows.original: Uhhhh...
rows.translation: 呃呃呃...
rows.raw: "\n\nUhhhh..."

rows.original: “As I said, it is not my intention to be unfriendly or cold. But the idea of having a full third of my mental faculties stripped is difficult to countenance. Not to mention the lingering possibility of mishap in surgery, or mental defect. Having grey-matter implants removed completely is rare and dangerous, even today. I am... content to be difficult to talk to. My job requires little more than terse call and response, after all.”
rows.translation: “我说过，我并非有意表现得不友善或冷漠。但要我接受自己的全部心智能力被剥除整整三分之一，实在很困难。更不用说手术仍有可能发生意外，或造成心智缺陷。即便在今天，彻底移除灰质植入体也很罕见，而且十分危险。我...宁愿满足于难以交谈这个缺点。毕竟，我的工作只需要简短地呼叫与应答。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As I said, it is not my intention to be unfriendly or cold. But the idea of having a full third of my mental faculties stripped is difficult to countenance. Not to mention the lingering possibility of mishap in surgery, or mental defect. Having grey-matter implants removed completely is rare and dangerous, even today. I am... content to be difficult to talk to. My job requires little more than terse call and response, after all.”"

rows.original: “Though I do... I appreciate your taking the time to talk to me, Captain. I know I am not the easiest person to converse with, even among this station’s population.”
rows.translation: “不过我的确...我很感谢您花时间与我交谈，船长。我知道即便在这座空间站的人群中，我也不是最容易聊天的对象。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Though I do... I appreciate your taking the time to talk to me, Captain. I know I am not the easiest person to converse with, even among this station’s population.”"

rows.original: “Except when a very nosy captain decides to be the first person in months to engage me in conversation...”
rows.translation: “除非一位非常爱打听的船长决定成为数月以来第一个和我交谈的人...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Except when a very nosy captain decides to be the first person in months to engage me in conversation...”"

rows.original: If you didn’t know better, you’d say Sub-Commander Brandt here sounds very, very lonely.
rows.translation: 要不是更了解情况，你会说这里的布兰特副指挥官听起来非常、非常孤独。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you didn’t know better, you’d say Sub-Commander Brandt here sounds very, very lonely."

rows.original: The hint of rose that comes to her cheeks when you say it is all but hidden by her dark, bronzed skin... but it’s there, sure as the little twist of her tail behind her or the sudden swallow. “I... um, I don’t mean to sound that way.”
rows.translation: 你说出这话时，她脸颊浮现的淡淡玫瑰色几乎完全被深沉的古铜肤色掩盖...但它确实存在，就像她在身后轻轻扭动的尾巴，还有突然吞咽的动作一样明显。“我...呃，我不是有意让自己听起来像那样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe hint of rose that comes to her cheeks when you say it is all but hidden by her dark, bronzed skin... but it’s there, sure as the little twist of her tail behind her or the sudden swallow. “I... um, I don’t mean to sound that way.”"

rows.original: But she does.
rows.translation: 但她听起来就是如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut she does."

rows.original: ...Are you wrong?
rows.translation: ...你说错了吗？
rows.raw: "\n\n...Are you wrong?"

rows.original: Brandt stiffens, snaps her arms behind her back, and looks you dead in the eye.
rows.translation: 布兰特身体一僵，双臂猛地背到身后，直视你的双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt stiffens, snaps her arms behind her back, and looks you dead in the eye."

rows.original: “If... if you wish to talk more privately, Captain Steele, you are welcome to accompany me back to my office. It is high time I took a short break.”
rows.translation: “如果...如果您想更私下地交谈，斯蒂尔船长，欢迎您陪我回办公室。也该到我短暂休息的时候了。”
rows.raw: " “If... if you wish to talk more privately, Captain Steele, you are welcome to accompany me back to my office. It is high time I took a short break.”"

rows.original: One of the goons behind her chuckles, and gets a swift tail-smack in the thigh for it.
rows.translation: 她身后的一名打手笑出声，立刻被她甩尾抽中了大腿。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the goons behind her chuckles, and gets a swift tail-smack in the thigh for it."

rows.original: “You are not. Now that you have successfully extracted that information, what would you like to do with it? Did you simply want me to admit that in front of my subordinates,” she growls, waving a hand back at the two beefy security goons standing behind her, “...or did you have a point to make?”
rows.translation: “你没有说错。现在你已经成功套出了这条信息，准备拿它做什么？你只是想让我当着下属的面承认这一点吗，”她低吼着，一只手挥向身后两名魁梧的安保打手，“...还是说，你有什么用意？”
rows.raw: " “You are not. Now that you have successfully extracted that information, what would you like to do with it? Did you simply want me to admit that in front of my subordinates,” she growls, waving a hand back at the two beefy security goons standing behind her, “...or did you have a point to make?”"

rows.original: You take a step back, trying to mask the surprise at the sudden razor-sharp verbal slap the normally even-toned officer just dropped across your face.
rows.translation: 你后退一步，努力掩饰惊讶；这个平时语调平稳的军官刚刚用锋利如刀的言语狠狠扇了你一巴掌。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a step back, trying to mask the surprise at the sudden razor-sharp verbal slap the normally even-toned officer just dropped across your face."

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: You could help her with the loneliness thing...
rows.translation: 你可以帮她解决孤独的问题...
rows.raw: "You could help her with the loneliness thing..."

rows.original: Just Asking...
rows.translation: 只是问问...
rows.raw: "Just Asking..."

rows.original: Just Asking...
rows.translation: 只是问问...
rows.raw: "Just Asking..."

rows.original: You were just asking... maybe trying to make her feel better, if you could get that out of her?
rows.translation: 你只是随口问问...也许是在努力让她感觉好一点，前提是你能让她说出口？
rows.raw: "You were just asking... maybe trying to make her feel better, if you could get that out of her?"

rows.original: Tease
rows.translation: 逗她
rows.raw: "Tease"

rows.original: Tease
rows.translation: 逗她
rows.raw: "Tease"

rows.original: You just wanted her to say it!
rows.translation: 你只是想让她亲口承认！
rows.raw: "You just wanted her to say it!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Penal station Gastigoth is fairly typical for its purpose,” she answers, so quickly you almost think it’s a V.I.’s programmed response. “The superstructure is owned by Nova daughter company Faangnis Corrections, with personnel drawn from both corporations. While dedicated corrections departments may be common in the galactic core, few such private companies operate facilities as large or intensive as Gastigoth. For that reason, as well as the added risk of piracy, armed escape attempts, and other direct hazards, it is hardly surprising that a maximum security suite would be operated by a private military contractor, no?”
rows.translation: “监狱站加斯提戈斯就其用途而言相当典型，”她回答得太快，你几乎以为这是虚拟智能的预设回应。“空间站主体归新星旗下公司方尼斯惩教所有，人员则由两家公司共同调派。专门的惩教部门在银河核心区域或许很常见，但很少有此类私人公司运营规模和管控强度与加斯提戈斯相当的设施。正因如此，再加上海盗、武装越狱及其他直接危险的额外风险，一套最高安全级别设施由私人军事承包商运营，完全不足为奇，不是吗？”
rows.raw: "“Penal station Gastigoth is fairly typical for its purpose,” she answers, so quickly you almost think it’s a V.I.’s programmed response. “The superstructure is owned by Nova daughter company Faangnis Corrections, with personnel drawn from both corporations. While dedicated corrections departments may be common in the galactic core, few such private companies operate facilities as large or intensive as Gastigoth. For that reason, as well as the added risk of piracy, armed escape attempts, and other direct hazards, it is hardly surprising that a maximum security suite would be operated by a private military contractor, no?”"

rows.original: In other words, Nova Securities is here to keep a prison break from happening?
rows.translation: 换句话说，新星安保驻扎这里，是为了防止有人劫狱？
rows.raw: "\n\nIn other words, Nova Securities is here to keep a prison break from happening?"

rows.original: Brandt nods sharply. “The greatest threat to a station such as Gastigoth is not internal strife, but an external attack. When private correction stations were first put into practice along the galactic frontier, they were frequently the target of criminal raids - either to free their compatriots, reinforce their crews, or to take slaves. In response, companies like Faangnis allowed themselves to be purchased and retooled by professional security contractors.”
rows.translation: 布兰特利落地点头。“对加斯提戈斯站这种空间站而言，最大的威胁不是内部冲突，而是外部袭击。私人惩教站最初在银河边境投入运营时，经常成为犯罪团伙袭击的目标--目的可能是释放同伙、补充成员，或者掳掠奴隶。作为回应，方尼斯之类的公司允许专业安保承包商收购并改造自己。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt nods sharply. “The greatest threat to a station such as Gastigoth is not internal strife, but an external attack. When private correction stations were first put into practice along the galactic frontier, they were frequently the target of criminal raids - either to free their compatriots, reinforce their crews, or to take slaves. In response, companies like Faangnis allowed themselves to be purchased and retooled by professional security contractors.”"

rows.original: “So why no risk from inside?” you ask.
rows.translation: “那为什么不用担心内部风险？”你问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So why no risk from inside?” you ask."

rows.original: The answer comes with a slight nod of her head towards the window behind you. “Where would the prisoners go if they broke out? That is the chief advantage to penal stations: a lack of escape possibility. Even if the prisoners took control of the station, there are only ever a handful of small craft available for them to steal. Heavy craft are not permitted within the security zone to avoid possible hijackings.”
rows.translation: 她朝你身后窗户微微点头，答案不言自明。“囚犯逃出去后能去哪里？这就是监狱站最主要的优势：不存在逃生可能。即便囚犯控制了空间站，也永远只有寥寥几艘可供偷走的小型飞船。为避免劫持，重型飞船不得进入安全区域。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe answer comes with a slight nod of her head towards the window behind you. “Where would the prisoners go if they broke out? That is the chief advantage to penal stations: a lack of escape possibility. Even if the prisoners took control of the station, there are only ever a handful of small craft available for them to steal. Heavy craft are not permitted within the security zone to avoid possible hijackings.”"

rows.original: “And, of course, space is also a weapon in its own right. Should the prisoners rebel, we are fully within our legal authority to shunt sections of the station into vacuum.”
rows.translation: “当然，太空本身也是武器。如果囚犯叛乱，我们完全有合法权力将空间站的部分区段排入真空。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And, of course, space is also a weapon in its own right. Should the prisoners rebel, we are fully within our legal authority to shunt sections of the station into vacuum.”"

rows.original: Oh. Well, that’d do it.
rows.translation: 哦。好吧，那确实管用。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh. Well, that’d do it."

rows.original: Brandt shrugs. “Spacing our prisoners is a last resort, of course. As you have likely noticed, Gastigoth is equipped with the best modern security has to offer to prevent such an unfortunate event. Aside from security personnel and riot officers, we have hundreds of armed drones throughout the station, plus security force-fields, chemical suppression systems, and of course, basic shock collars and electrified deck and hull plating. Killing prisoners does not earn the station any funding from the governments that sponsor us, so it is in fact in our best interest to hurt, not kill, should the need arise. In my years of service here, it thus far has not.”
rows.translation: 布兰特耸肩。“当然，把囚犯排入太空只是最后手段。你大概已经注意到，加斯提戈斯站配备了现代安保技术所能提供的最佳设备，以防止这种不幸事件发生。除了安保人员和防暴人员，空间站各处还有数百架武装无人机，以及安保力场、化学压制系统，当然也包括基本的电击项圈和通电甲板及船体装甲。杀死囚犯无法从赞助我们的政府那里获得任何资金，所以一旦有需要，伤而不杀才真正符合我们的最佳利益。我在这里服役这些年，至今还没有出现过那种需要。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt shrugs. “Spacing our prisoners is a last resort, of course. As you have likely noticed, Gastigoth is equipped with the best modern security has to offer to prevent such an unfortunate event. Aside from security personnel and riot officers, we have hundreds of armed drones throughout the station, plus security force-fields, chemical suppression systems, and of course, basic shock collars and electrified deck and hull plating. Killing prisoners does not earn the station any funding from the governments that sponsor us, so it is in fact in our best interest to hurt, not kill, should the need arise. In my years of service here, it thus far has not.”"

rows.original: Huh, considering all the security around here - and the insane amount of firepower she was threatening you with on your way in - you’d have thought there’d but a lot more... space murder going on.
rows.translation: 呃，考虑到这里到处都是安保设施--还有她在你进来时用来威胁你的疯狂火力--你原以为这里会发生更多...太空谋杀。
rows.raw: "\n\nHuh, considering all the security around here - and the insane amount of firepower she was threatening you with on your way in - you’d have thought there’d but a lot more... space murder going on."

rows.original: The commander gives you the faintest hint of a smile. “That is the image we like to cultivate. Appearing like an impregnable fortress has its benefits, chiefly instilling an aversion to attempting an assault on the station. While Gastigoth has only a fraction of the power of a Terran super-carrier like my Volsung, I assure you it is more than sufficient to counter even a concerted Black Void assault. Any prisoners remanded here after your adventures will be quite secure.”
rows.translation: 指挥官露出一丝几不可见的微笑。“这正是我们喜欢塑造的形象。表现得像一座坚不可摧的堡垒自有好处，其中最主要的一点，就是让人打消进攻空间站的念头。尽管加斯提戈斯站的火力只有我的沃尔松号这类泰伦超级航母的一小部分，但我向你保证，即便黑色虚空发动协同突袭，它也绰绰有余。你冒险后移交到这里的任何囚犯都会被严加看管。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe commander gives you the faintest hint of a smile. “That is the image we like to cultivate. Appearing like an impregnable fortress has its benefits, chiefly instilling an aversion to attempting an assault on the station. While Gastigoth has only a fraction of the power of a Terran super-carrier like my Volsung, I assure you it is more than sufficient to counter even a concerted Black Void assault. Any prisoners remanded here after your adventures will be quite secure.”"

rows.original: You can see that. So, aside from keeping people locked up, what does Gastigoth do with its prisoners? Surely there’s something that makes it different than just any other station.
rows.translation: 这一点你看得出来。那么，除了把人关起来，加斯提戈斯站还会如何处置囚犯？它肯定有什么地方不同于普通空间站。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see that. So, aside from keeping people locked up, what does Gastigoth do with its prisoners? Surely there’s something that makes it different than just any other station."

rows.original: “Well,” the half-lizard woman says, shifting her weight, “Our facility is primarily dedicated to holding and correction for ultra-high-risk prisoners - either due to their individual talents, or due to their connections. Still, you are right to assume that our station provides... alternative corrective measure, somewhat more... intensive than those common in government-run prisons. Or ones with more moral oversight.”
rows.translation: “嗯，”这个半蜥蜴女人移动重心，说道，“本设施主要负责拘押和矫正超高风险囚犯--风险可能来自个人能力，也可能来自人际关系。不过你猜得没错，我们的空间站确实会提供...另类矫正措施，比政府经营的监狱常见手段更...严厉一些。或者说，比那些受到更多道德监督的监狱更严厉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well,” the half-lizard woman says, shifting her weight, “Our facility is primarily dedicated to holding and correction for ultra-high-risk prisoners - either due to their individual talents, or due to their connections. Still, you are right to assume that our station provides... alternative corrective measure, somewhat more... intensive than those common in government-run prisons. Or ones with more moral oversight.”"

rows.original: That doesn’t sound good, coming from someone working here.
rows.translation: 这话从一个在这里工作的人嘴里说出来，听着可不妙。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat doesn’t sound good, coming from someone working here."

rows.original: “I make no judgement on you, the Warden, or our other patrons,” she answers sharply. “I simply mean that by most galactic standards of morality, the means we use for punishment are somewhat esoteric, if not extreme. Then again, we don’t engage in outright torture or the violent barbarism common on less civilized frontier planets like Myrellion or Phaedra. The majority of our corrective measures would fall well within the rights of, say, a master and a deeply indentured servant. One that had made a very, very loose contract.”
rows.translation: “我不评价你、典狱长或我们的其他客户，”她尖锐地回答。“我的意思只是，按照银河大多数道德标准，我们采用的惩罚手段相当另类，即便算不上极端。话说回来，我们不会实施赤裸裸的酷刑，也没有米瑞利恩或菲德拉这类欠文明边境行星常见的暴力野蛮行径。我们的绝大多数矫正措施都完全处于，比如说，主人对深度契约仆人所拥有的权利范围内。只不过那名仆人签下的合同非常、非常宽松。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I make no judgement on you, the Warden, or our other patrons,” she answers sharply. “I simply mean that by most galactic standards of morality, the means we use for punishment are somewhat esoteric, if not extreme. Then again, we don’t engage in outright torture or the violent barbarism common on less civilized frontier planets like Myrellion or Phaedra. The majority of our corrective measures would fall well within the rights of, say, a master and a deeply indentured servant. One that had made a very, very loose contract.”"

rows.original: Uh-huh.
rows.translation: 嗯哼。
rows.raw: "\n\nUh-huh."

rows.original: You wonder if these folks have any relation to a certain slaver mistress you’ve met...
rows.translation: 你想知道这些人是否和你遇到过的某位奴隶女主人有关系...
rows.raw: " You wonder if these folks have any relation to a certain slaver mistress you’ve met..."

rows.original: Brandt curls her tail under her, wrapping her legs in its scaly embrace. “Anything else you’d like to discuss, captain? I’m afraid querying the specifics of our programs would be better left to the Warden.”
rows.translation: 布兰特把尾巴卷到身下，用覆有鳞片的尾巴环住双腿。“还有什么想谈的吗，船长？恐怕若要询问我们项目的具体细节，最好还是交给典狱长回答。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt curls her tail under her, wrapping her legs in its scaly embrace. “Anything else you’d like to discuss, captain? I’m afraid querying the specifics of our programs would be better left to the Warden.”"

rows.original: Gastigoth
rows.raw: "Gastigoth"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: You approach Brandt and say that you’d like to have your gear back now.
rows.translation: 你走向布兰特，表示现在想取回装备。
rows.raw: "You approach Brandt and say that you’d like to have your gear back now."

rows.original: “Of course,” she says, reaching under the security station and retrieving the bucket you stowed your weapons in. You spend a few moments getting your equipment sorted out, back the way you like it, before stepping back towards the airlock.
rows.translation: “当然，”她说道，伸手从安检台下取出你用来存放武器的桶。你花了片刻整理装备，恢复自己喜欢的配置，随后朝气闸退去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course,” she says, reaching under the security station and retrieving the bucket you stowed your weapons in. You spend a few moments getting your equipment sorted out, back the way you like it, before stepping back towards the airlock."

rows.original: “Alright. See you again soon, I hope,” she says, giving you that faint little smile of hers.
rows.translation: “好吧。希望很快再见，”她说道，露出那一丝浅浅的微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright. See you again soon, I hope,” she says, giving you that faint little smile of hers."

rows.original: “Have a safe journey, captain,” the security commander says, giving you a slight nod. “Please return to your ship and we will guide you out of the security zone.”
rows.translation: “祝您一路平安，船长，”安保指挥官略微点头说道。“请返回飞船，我们会引导您离开安全区域。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Have a safe journey, captain,” the security commander says, giving you a slight nod. “Please return to your ship and we will guide you out of the security zone.”"

rows.original: You nod and turn to leave.
rows.translation: 你点头，转身离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and turn to leave."

rows.original: You approach Brandt and say that you’re ready to be disarmed.
rows.translation: 你走向布兰特，表示自己已经准备好解除武装。
rows.raw: "You approach Brandt and say that you’re ready to be disarmed."

rows.original: “Good. Welcome aboard, captain,” she says, pulling out a heavy-duty tub from under the station and pushing it towards you. The two armored goons with shock rifles eye you warily so that you make sure you go nice and slow, taking your time drawing your [pc.weapon]
rows.translation: “很好。欢迎登站，船长，”她说道，从安检台下拉出一个重型收纳桶，推到你面前。两名手持电击步枪的装甲打手警惕地盯着你，确保你动作足够缓慢；你不慌不忙地拔出[pc.weapon]
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good. Welcome aboard, captain,” she says, pulling out a heavy-duty tub from under the station and pushing it towards you. The two armored goons with shock rifles eye you warily so that you make sure you go nice and slow, taking your time drawing your [pc.weapon]"

rows.original: , making sure it’s safe and setting it inside.
rows.translation: ，确认安全后将其放入桶中。
rows.raw: ", making sure it’s safe and setting it inside."

rows.original: Brandt watches you impassively until you indicate that you’re finished, at which point she picks up an electronic wand from under the station and waves you forward. You step up, just to arm’s reach before she plants one hand on your chest and sweeps the wand around your person. It makes a soft, ticking beep until Brandt gives a satisfied nod and tucks it away.
rows.translation: 布兰特面无表情地看着你，直到你示意自己已经完成；随后她从安检台下拿起一根电子扫描棒，挥手让你上前。你走到她一臂范围内，她一只手按在你胸口，另一只手用扫描棒扫过全身。仪器发出轻柔而连续的滴答声，直到布兰特满意地点头，将它收起。
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandt watches you impassively until you indicate that you’re finished, at which point she picks up an electronic wand from under the station and waves you forward. You step up, just to arm’s reach before she plants one hand on your chest and sweeps the wand around your person. It makes a soft, ticking beep until Brandt gives a satisfied nod and tucks it away."

rows.original: “Clear. You’re free to proceed, captain.”
rows.translation: “安全。您可以继续前进了，船长。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Clear. You’re free to proceed, captain.”"

rows.original: In you go, then.
rows.translation: 那么，进去吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn you go, then."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The same half-reptilian woman you were talked at by on the vid call is standing here, crisply at attention behind a security station.
rows.translation: 视频通话里那个单方面对你说话的半爬行类女人就站在这里，在安检台后保持着利落的立正姿势。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe same half-reptilian woman you were talked at by on the vid call is standing here, crisply at attention behind a security station."

rows.original: Command Brandt takes her place at the security station, awaiting you.
rows.translation: 布兰特指挥官在安检台就位，等待着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nCommand Brandt takes her place at the security station, awaiting you."

rows.original: A pair of humanoids in full body armor and shaded breath masks stand behind her, couching stun rifles under an arm and hardlight-projected riot shields braced beside them.
rows.translation: 她身后站着一对全身披甲、戴有色呼吸面罩的人形生物，臂弯夹着电击步枪，身旁撑着硬光投影防暴盾。
rows.raw: " A pair of humanoids in full body armor and shaded breath masks stand behind her, couching stun rifles under an arm and hardlight-projected riot shields braced beside them."

rows.original: Officer
rows.translation: 军官
rows.raw: "Officer"

rows.original: Officer
rows.translation: 军官
rows.raw: "Officer"

rows.original: Go over to the Nova Securities officer and see what she wants.
rows.translation: 走向那名新星安保军官，看看她想要什么。
rows.raw: "Go over to the Nova Securities officer and see what she wants."

rows.original: Brandt
rows.translation: 布兰特
rows.raw: "Brandt"

rows.original: Brandt
rows.translation: 布兰特
rows.raw: "Brandt"

rows.original: Talk to Commander Brandt.
rows.translation: 与布兰特指挥官交谈。
rows.raw: "Talk to Commander Brandt."

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: You check your gear with Brandt and continue into the station.
rows.translation: 你把装备交给布兰特寄存，随后继续深入空间站。
rows.raw: "You check your gear with Brandt and continue into the station.\n\n"

rows.original:
The corridor here connects the docking tether back the way you first came in with two other corridors, both clearly labeled in several languages: to the north, Command & Control. Westward, the Lobby. Of course, south is back to Security. The bulkheads in every direction are otherwise sterile, gray, and bristling with gun turrets. Uniformly, though, there’s a tiny potted tree every thirty feet or so - the only life in this place, aside from your armed companion.

Commander Brandt follows a pace behind you in locked step, her arms folded behind her back and her face implacable as ever.
rows.translation:
这里的走廊一端连接着你初次进入时经过的对接通道，另外两端则分别通向两条走廊；每一条都以数种语言清楚标示：北边是指挥与控制部，西边是大厅，南边当然是返回安检区。除此之外，各个方向的舱壁都同样无菌、灰暗，布满炮塔。不过每隔约三十英尺总会摆着一棵小盆栽树--除了你的武装同伴，这是此处唯一的生命。

布兰特指挥官步伐严整地跟在你身后一拍距离，双臂背在身后，神情一如既往地不可动摇。
rows.raw: "The corridor here connects the docking tether back the way you first came in with two other corridors, both clearly labeled in several languages: to the north, Command & Control. Westward, the Lobby. Of course, south is back to Security. The bulkheads in every direction are otherwise sterile, gray, and bristling with gun turrets. Uniformly, though, there’s a tiny potted tree every thirty feet or so - the only life in this place, aside from your armed companion.\n\nCommander Brandt follows a pace behind you in locked step, her arms folded behind her back and her face implacable as ever."

rows.original: Halt Armed Scum!
rows.translation: 持械恶徒，站住！
rows.raw: "Halt Armed Scum!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: The moment you try to go anywhere, the two goons in orange armor stomp up and lock shields, all but jamming the shimmering projections in your face.
rows.translation: 你一试图前往任何地方，两名身穿橙色装甲的打手便重步上前，锁住盾牌，几乎把闪烁的投影抵到你脸上。
rows.raw: "The moment you try to go anywhere, the two goons in orange armor stomp up and lock shields, all but jamming the shimmering projections in your face."

rows.original: “I’m afraid we’ll be relieving you of your weapons, Captain,” the woman behind the station says, giving you a flat look. “No arms, shields, explosives, or any other means of combat are permitted beyond this point. No matter how small, secure, or primitive. This is for your safety and ours; I take no particular pleasure is disarming you.”
rows.translation: “恐怕我们得暂时收走您的武器，船长，”安检台后的女人面无表情地看着你说道。“从这里往后，禁止携带武器、护盾、爆炸物或任何其他战斗手段。无论它多小、多安全或多原始。这是为了您和我们的安全；我本人并不会从解除您的武装中获得任何特殊乐趣。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m afraid we’ll be relieving you of your weapons, Captain,” the woman behind the station says, giving you a flat look. “No arms, shields, explosives, or any other means of combat are permitted beyond this point. No matter how small, secure, or primitive. This is for your safety and ours; I take no particular pleasure is disarming you.”"

rows.original: Dammit.
rows.translation: 该死。
rows.raw: "\n\nDammit."

rows.original: I16_SECURITY_CHECKPOINT
rows.raw: "I16_SECURITY_CHECKPOINT"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: You reclaim your gear from Brandt and proceed back to your ship.
rows.translation: 你从布兰特那里取回装备，返回自己的飞船。
rows.raw: "You reclaim your gear from Brandt and proceed back to your ship.\n\n"

rows.original: Your ship is currently parked at the end of a short docking umbilical, connecting you to a sterile gray corridor that runs into the station. Your berth is one of many visible from the umbilical windows, all connected to different parts of the station. Supposedly, your berth is reserved for special guests - guess you’re important.
rows.translation: 你的飞船目前停在一条短对接通道尽头，通道将你与一条深入空间站的无菌灰色走廊相连。从通道窗户可以看见许多泊位，你的只是其中之一，每个泊位都连接着空间站的不同部分。据说你的泊位专为特殊访客预留--看来你还挺重要。
rows.raw: "Your ship is currently parked at the end of a short docking umbilical, connecting you to a sterile gray corridor that runs into the station. Your berth is one of many visible from the umbilical windows, all connected to different parts of the station. Supposedly, your berth is reserved for special guests - guess you’re important."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Access Denied
rows.translation: 拒绝访问
rows.raw: "Access Denied"

rows.original: A pair of security drones step up from the shadows and stare you down impassively, their metal fingers seamlessly integrated into a pair of pulse carbines.
rows.translation: 一对安保无人机从阴影中上前，面无表情地逼视着你；它们的金属手指与一对脉冲卡宾枪无缝融合在一起。
rows.raw: "A pair of security drones step up from the shadows and stare you down impassively, their metal fingers seamlessly integrated into a pair of pulse carbines."

rows.original: “I do not believe you have any business in our command room at present, Captain,” Brandt says evenly from behind you. “Neither do they, it seems.”
rows.translation: “我认为您目前在我们的指挥室没有任何事务，船长，”布兰特在你身后平静说道。“看来它们也这么认为。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I do not believe you have any business in our command room at present, Captain,” Brandt says evenly from behind you. “Neither do they, it seems.”"

rows.original: The drones make no move or sound, but the threat hangs in the air until you take a step back. They give you a slight nod and retreat as well, bracing their backs against the bulkheads on either side of the door.
rows.translation: 无人机一动不动，也没有发出声音，但威胁始终悬在空中，直到你后退一步。它们也微微点头并退开，将背部抵在门两侧的舱壁上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe drones make no move or sound, but the threat hangs in the air until you take a step back. They give you a slight nod and retreat as well, bracing their backs against the bulkheads on either side of the door."

rows.original: I14_CORRIDOR
rows.raw: "I14_CORRIDOR"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Access Granted
rows.translation: 允许访问
rows.raw: "Access Granted"

rows.original: “At ease, gentlemen,” Brandt says, waving the drones aside with her security card. They beep at her and remain at their posts, allowing you to pass.
rows.translation: “稍息，先生们，”布兰特说着，用安保卡示意无人机让开。它们冲她发出提示音，留在自己的岗位上，放你通行。
rows.raw: "“At ease, gentlemen,” Brandt says, waving the drones aside with her security card. They beep at her and remain at their posts, allowing you to pass.\n\n"

rows.original: Gastigoth’s C&C room is a single, sweeping circular chamber some fifty feet wide. rows.original: Commander Brandt guides you through a lengthy corridor, taking you deep into the ship-sized security center until it opens up into a sweeping, circular lobby. A glass table dominates the middle, flanked by a pair of curved couches on the entrance’s side and the opposite, and a pair of small potted plants at either end. We restrict the number and size of vessels docked here at any given time, so the possibility of escape is severely restricted. Plus, the station is under constant surveillance from the Confederacy and several planetary governments, ensuring any attempted takeover -from inside or out - can be countered swiftly. In other words, Gastigoth is nigh unassailable: a perfect place for the scum we house.”
